(set-logic QF_LRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (covenant_in_effect Bool) ; Article VI is in force at this observation: Commitments not yet expired/terminated, or Loans, Fees, other amounts not paid in full, or Letters of Credit not expired/terminated or LC Disbursements not reimbursed
  (is_covered_event Bool) ; At this observation a Loan Party or Restricted Subsidiary sells, transfers, leases or otherwise disposes of an asset (incl. Equity Interests), or the Borrower permits a Subsidiary (incl. Unrestricted) to issue additional Equity Interest in itself
  (fair_value Bool) ; The covered disposition/issuance is made for fair value
  (cash_consideration_pct Real) ; Percent (0-100 scale) of total consideration for the event received in cash
  (is_clause_i Bool) ; Event is a sale of inventory or used, surplus, obsolete, outdated, inefficient or worn out equipment and other property in the ordinary course of business
  (is_to_borrower_or_sub_loan_party Bool) ; Event is a sale/transfer/disposition to the Borrower or another Subsidiary Loan Party
  (is_to_bioglan Bool) ; The transferee of the event is Bioglan
  (collateral_actions_taken Bool) ; Loan Parties have taken all actions necessary or reasonably requested by the Collateral Agent to maintain/perfect/protect/preserve Liens on the Collateral and comply with Sections 5.11 and 5.12 where applicable
  (is_real_property_lease_ordinary_course Bool) ; Event is a lease or sublease of Real Property in the ordinary course of business
  (is_sale_leaseback Bool) ; The Real Property lease/sublease constitutes a sale and leaseback transaction
  (is_permitted_investments_sale Bool) ; Event is a sale of Permitted Investments
  (is_pharmabio_investment_sale Bool) ; Event is a sale of Permitted PharmaBio Investments (clause (v)(A))
  (is_pharmabio_swap Bool) ; Event is a Permitted PharmaBio Swap (clause (v)(B))
  (is_non_operating_investment Bool) ; The clause (v) sale or swap is of Non-Operating Investments
  (pro_forma_compliant_6_13_to_6_16 Bool) ; After giving effect to the sale/swap (and other PharmaBio sales/swaps since the last day of the preceding Test Period) pro forma as the proviso describes, the Borrower would comply with Sections 6.13 through 6.16 inclusive
  (is_investment_permitted_6_04 Bool) ; Event is a transfer of assets constituting Investments permitted under Section 6.04
  (is_asian_sub_equity_issuance Bool) ; Event is an issuance by a Designated Asian Subsidiary of its Equity Interests
  (is_public_offering_or_strategic_institutional_sale Bool) ; The issuance is in connection with a public offering of Equity Interests or a sale of Equity Interests to a strategic or institutional investor
  (borrower_restricted_ownership_pct Real) ; Percent (0-100 scale) of the Designated Asian Subsidiary's outstanding Equity Interests, fully diluted, owned by the Borrower and Restricted Subsidiaries after the issuance
  (issuance_proceeds_retained_reinvested Bool) ; Net proceeds of the issuance are retained by the Designated Asian Subsidiary and reinvested in its business
  (issuance_proceeds_applied_prepayment Bool) ; Net proceeds of the issuance are applied toward prepayment of Loans to the extent required by Section 2.06(c)(iii), with the modified 270/540-day deadline
  (is_between_wholly_owned_non_us_subs Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets between Wholly Owned Non-U.S. Subsidiaries
  (is_contemplated_by_6_01_a_ix_1 Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets as contemplated by Section 6.01(a)(ix)(1)
  (is_clause_x_disposition Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets not otherwise permitted under this Section, relied on under clause (x)
  (is_equity_of_restricted_sub Bool) ; The assets disposed of under clause (x) are Equity Interests of a Restricted Subsidiary
  (fy_clause_x_fmv Real) ; Aggregate fair market value in USD of all assets disposed of in reliance on clause (x) in the current Fiscal Year, including this event
  (cumulative_clause_x_fmv Real) ; Aggregate fair market value in USD of all assets disposed of in reliance on clause (x) since inception, including this event
  (clause_x_net_proceeds_applied Bool) ; Net Proceeds of the clause (x) disposition are applied as required by Section 2.06(c)(iii)
) Bool
  (=> (and covenant_in_effect is_covered_event)
      (and fair_value
           (or
             ;; (i)
             is_clause_i
             ;; (ii)
             (and is_to_borrower_or_sub_loan_party (not is_to_bioglan) collateral_actions_taken)
             ;; (iii)
             (and is_real_property_lease_ordinary_course (not is_sale_leaseback))
             ;; (iv) 100% cash
             (and is_permitted_investments_sale (>= cash_consideration_pct 100))
             ;; (v) (A) needs at least 75% cash; proviso waived for Non-Operating Investments
             (and (or (and is_pharmabio_investment_sale (>= cash_consideration_pct 75))
                      is_pharmabio_swap)
                  (or is_non_operating_investment pro_forma_compliant_6_13_to_6_16))
             ;; (vi)
             is_investment_permitted_6_04
             ;; (vii) 100% cash
             (and is_asian_sub_equity_issuance
                  is_public_offering_or_strategic_institutional_sale
                  (>= borrower_restricted_ownership_pct 65)
                  (or issuance_proceeds_retained_reinvested issuance_proceeds_applied_prepayment)
                  (>= cash_consideration_pct 100))
             ;; (viii)
             is_between_wholly_owned_non_us_subs
             ;; (ix)
             is_contemplated_by_6_01_a_ix_1
             ;; (x) 100% cash
             (and is_clause_x_disposition
                  (not is_equity_of_restricted_sub)
                  (<= fy_clause_x_fmv 35000000)
                  (<= cumulative_clause_x_fmv 100000000)
                  clause_x_net_proceeds_applied
                  (>= cash_consideration_pct 100))))))

semantic_judge.reason: The pointwise implication is: if the covenant is in effect and a covered disposition or issuance occurs, then fair value holds and at least one exception clause is satisfied. Each exception matches the source. Clause (i), (iii) (lease not a sale-leaseback), (vi), (viii) and (ix) are direct flags. Clause (ii) requires a Borrower or Subsidiary Loan Party transferee, not Bioglan, plus the collateral actions. Clause (iv) requires 100% cash. Clause (v) requires at least 75% cash for sales but no cash test for swaps, with the pro forma proviso waived for Non-Operating Investments. Clause (vii) requires a public offering or strategic/institutional sale, at least 65% retained ownership, proceeds reinvested or applied to prepayment, and 100% cash. Clause (x) excludes Equity Interests of a Restricted Subsidiary, caps the Fiscal Year total at $35M and the aggregate at $100M, requires the Net Proceeds application, and requires 100% cash. The pro forma compliance and prepayment-deadline conditions are atomic Boolean inputs with clear meanings, which fits the task convention because Sections 6.13 to 6.16 and 2.06 are not supplied. All parameters are documented precisely, no division occurs, and no unsupported financial assumptions are introduced.

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; commitments_outstanding: true if the Commitments have NOT yet expired or been terminated at the observation time.
; loans_or_fees_unpaid: true if the principal of or interest on any Loan, or any fee payable under the agreement, has NOT been paid in full at the observation time.
; letters_of_credit_outstanding: true if any Letter of Credit has NOT yet expired or terminated at the observation time.
; lc_disbursements_unreimbursed: true if any L/C Disbursement has NOT yet been reimbursed at the observation time.
; consolidated_ebitda: Consolidated EBITDA of the Borrower for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending at the observation time (currency units).

(define-fun covenant_holds ((commitments_outstanding Bool) (loans_or_fees_unpaid Bool) (letters_of_credit_outstanding Bool) (lc_disbursements_unreimbursed Bool) (consolidated_ebitda Real) (consolidated_cash_interest_expense Real)) Bool
  (=> (or commitments_outstanding loans_or_fees_unpaid letters_of_credit_outstanding lc_disbursements_unreimbursed)
      (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda consolidated_cash_interest_expense) 3.0)))

The covenant therefore applies while any one of them is still outstanding. The candidate encodes this as the disjunction of the four 'outstanding' flags, and each flag is precisely documented. The ratio's arithmetic is explicit, and division by zero is left to the evaluator's unresolved policy. Both Real inputs are documented with their entity, the four-fiscal-quarter period, and units, and no positivity or other domain assumptions are added. The four-quarter period ending at the observation time is a reasonable pointwise reading, since the evaluator chooses and supplies the relevant observation points.

; debt_to_capitalization_ratio: Debt to Capitalization Ratio of the Borrower at the observation time (Real, as a ratio, e.g. 0.75 means 0.75 to 1.0).
; in_period_date_hereof_to_2002_03_30: true iff the observation date is within the period from the date of the Agreement through 3/30/02.

; in_period_2003_03_31_to_2004_03_30: true iff the observation date is within 3/31/03 through 3/30/04.
; in_period_thereafter_debt_cap: true iff the observation date is after 3/30/04.
; prior_equity_issuance_no_commitment_reduction_event: true iff on some date on or before the observation date, and prior to March 30, 2003, the Borrower was not required to reduce the Aggregate Commitment upon receipt of proceeds of an Equity Issuance pursuant to clause (iii) of the proviso to Section 2.8(b).
; on_or_before_2003_03_30: true iff the observation date is on or before March 30, 2003.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; interest_coverage_ratio: Interest Coverage Ratio as of the last day of the fiscal quarter (Real, ratio).
; fq_ending_2001_06_30_to_2002_12_31: true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the observation date ends from 6/30/01 through 12/31/02.
; fq_ending_2003_03_31_to_2003_12_31: true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the observation date ends from 3/31/03 through 12/31/03.
; fq_ending_thereafter_interest_coverage: true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the observation date ends after 12/31/03.
; stockholders_equity: Stockholder's Equity of the Borrower at the observation time, in dollars.
; fiscal_year_net_income_sum_losses_floored: sum, in dollars, of consolidated net income of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries for each fiscal year ending after the date of the Agreement, with any fiscal year that is a loss counted as zero, and excluding the first fiscal quarter of the 2001 fiscal year.
; current_year_completed_portion_net_income: consolidated net income in dollars for the completed portion of the then-current fiscal year for which financial statements were delivered under Section 6.1(b), excluding the first fiscal quarter in the case of fiscal year 2001; 0 if not applicable. (define-fun covenant_holds (
  (debt_to_capitalization_ratio Real)
  (in_period_date_hereof_to_2002_03_30 Bool)
  (in_period_2002_03_31_to_2003_03_30 Bool)
  (in_period_2003_03_31_to_2004_03_30 Bool)
  (in_period_thereafter_debt_cap Bool)
  (prior_equity_issuance_no_commitment_reduction_event Bool)
  (on_or_before_2003_03_30 Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (interest_coverage_ratio Real)
  (fq_ending_2001_06_30_to_2002_12_31 Bool)
  (fq_ending_2003_03_31_to_2003_12_31 Bool)
  (fq_ending_thereafter_interest_coverage Bool)
  (stockholders_equity Real)
  (fiscal_year_net_income_sum_losses_floored Real)
  (current_year_completed_portion_net_income Real)
  (equity_issuance_net_proceeds_sum Real)
) Bool
  (and
    ; 6.4.1 maximum Debt to Capitalization Ratio
    (=> in_period_date_hereof_to_2002_03_30 (<= debt_to_capitalization_ratio 0.75))
    (=> in_period_2002_03_31_to_2003_03_30 (<= debt_to_capitalization_ratio 0.70))
    (=> in_period_2003_03_31_to_2004_03_30 (<= debt_to_capitalization_ratio 0.65))
    (=> in_period_thereafter_debt_cap (<= debt_to_capitalization_ratio 0.60))

        (<= debt_to_capitalization_ratio 0.65))
    ; 6.4.2 minimum Interest Coverage Ratio at fiscal quarter end

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fq_ending_2003_03_31_to_2003_12_31) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 4.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fq_ending_thereafter_interest_coverage) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 5.00))
    ; 6.4.3 Net Worth
    (>= stockholders_equity
        (+ 135000000.0
           (* 0.5 (+ fiscal_year_net_income_sum_losses_floored
                     (ite (> current_year_completed_portion_net_income 0.0)
                          current_year_completed_portion_net_income
                          0.0)))
           (* 0.75 equity_issuance_net_proceeds_sum)))
  )
)

  (other_amount_owing Bool) ; any other amount is owing to any Lender or the Administrative Agent hereunder at the observation time

  (leverage_date_tier_3_00 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 3.00 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2002 through Mar 31 2003 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_75 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.75 to 1.00 (Jun 30 2003 through Dec 31 2003 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_50 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.50 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2004 through Sep 30 2005 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_25 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.25 to 1.00 (Dec 31 2005 through Mar 31 2007 rows)

    (>= us_unencumbered_liquid_assets_fmv 20000000.0)))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; lender_has_commitment: true if any Lender has any Commitment at the observation time.
; loan_or_obligation_unpaid: true if any Loan or other Obligation remains unpaid or unsatisfied at the observation time.
; letter_of_credit_outstanding: true if any Letter of Credit remains outstanding at the observation time.
; is_borrower_fiscal_quarter_end: true if the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; is_on_or_after_dec_31_2006_quarter: true if the fiscal quarter ending at the observation date is the quarter ending December 31, 2006 or a later quarter.
; consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio: Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio as of the end of the fiscal quarter, as a number (3.0 means 3.0 to 1.0).
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the end of the fiscal quarter, as a number (3.75 means 3.75 to 1.0).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (lender_has_commitment Bool)
  (loan_or_obligation_unpaid Bool)
  (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
  (is_borrower_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_on_or_after_dec_31_2006_quarter Bool)
  (consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio Real)
  (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)) Bool
  (=> (and (or lender_has_commitment loan_or_obligation_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding)
           is_borrower_fiscal_quarter_end
           is_on_or_after_dec_31_2006_quarter)
      (and (not (< consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio 3.0))
           (not (> consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.75)))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (on_or_after_effective_date Bool) ; True if the observation is on or after the Effective Date.
  (commitments_terminated_and_obligations_paid Bool) ; True if the Total Revolving Loan Commitment and all Letters of Credit have terminated (or been cash collateralized or backstopped per Section 4.02(d)) and the Loans, Notes, Unpaid Drawings, interest, Fees and other Obligations (except Section 13.13 indemnities not then due) are paid in full.
  (sub_debt_payment_made Bool) ; True if Magellan, the Borrower or a Subsidiary makes (or gives notice of) a voluntary or optional payment, prepayment, redemption or acquisition for value of Permitted Subordinated Debt, including a prepayment or redemption from an asset sale, change of control or similar event, or a deposit of money or securities before due to pay it.
  (is_magellan_redemption_or_repurchase Bool) ; True if the sub_debt_payment_made action is a redemption or repurchase of outstanding Permitted Subordinated Debt effected by Magellan, the only action the provisos (A) and (B) can permit.
  (default_exists_or_would_result Bool) ; True if a Default or Event of Default then exists or would result from the redemption or repurchase.
  (fiscal_year_redemption_total Real) ; Aggregate USD amount expended on all Permitted Subordinated Debt redemptions and repurchases in the current fiscal year of Magellan, including the proposed one.
  (pro_forma_9_08_compliant Bool) ; True if Pro Forma Basis calculations for the Calculation Period show the Section 9.08 financial covenant would have been complied with as of the last day of that period.
  (pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio Real) ; Total Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Calculation Period, computed on the Pro Forma Basis as if the redemption or repurchase (and earlier ones in that period) occurred on its first day.
  (total_unutilized_revolving_commitment Real) ; Total Unutilized Revolving Loan Commitment then in effect, in USD, immediately after giving effect to the proposed redemption or repurchase.
  (unrestricted_cash_and_equivalents Real) ; Aggregate USD amount of all Unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of Magellan and its Subsidiaries at such time, immediately after giving effect to the proposed redemption or repurchase.
  (officer_certificate_delivered Bool) ; True if Magellan delivered to the Administrative Agent (with copies for each Lender) a certificate from an Authorized Officer certifying compliance with clauses (i) through (iii) and containing the required calculations.
  (sub_debt_document_executed Bool) ; True if a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document has been executed and delivered by this observation.
  (amends_sub_debt_document Bool) ; True if Magellan, the Borrower or a Subsidiary amends or modifies (or permits the amendment or modification of) a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (amendment_less_restrictive Bool) ; True if the amendment makes the provisions less restrictive on Magellan and its Subsidiaries (including any representation, warranty, covenant, default or event of default).
  (amendment_reduces_rates_or_fees Bool) ; True if the amendment reduces interest rates, commissions or fees paid or to be paid by Magellan or any Subsidiary in connection with the Permitted Subordinated Debt.
  (amendment_extends_maturity Bool) ; True if the amendment extends the stated maturity of any Indebtedness under the Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (amendment_reduces_prepayment_premiums Bool) ; True if the amendment reduces or eliminates any prepayment premiums.
  (amendment_not_materially_adverse_per_agent Bool) ; True if the amendment is otherwise not adverse to the Lenders in any material respect, in the reasonable opinion of the Administrative Agent.
  (amends_subordination_provisions Bool) ; True if the amendment or modification is to the subordination provisions of a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (agent_prior_written_consent_subordination Bool) ; True if the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent to the amendment of the subordination provisions.
  (amends_org_or_equity_documents Bool) ; True if Magellan or the Borrower amends, modifies or changes its certificate/articles of incorporation, formation certificate, LLC agreement, by-laws or equivalent, or any agreement on its capital stock or equity interests (including any Shareholders' Agreement), or enters into a new such agreement.
  (org_or_equity_change_not_materially_adverse Bool) ; True if the amendment, modification, change or other action could not reasonably be expected to be adverse to the interests of the Lenders in any material respect.
  (amends_or_enters_tax_sharing_agreement Bool) ; True if a Tax Tax-sharing action occurs: amendment or modification (or permitting it) of a Tax Sharing Agreement, or entry into a new tax sharing, tax allocation or similar agreement.
  (agent_prior_written_consent_tax Bool) ; True if the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent to the tax sharing amendment or new agreement.
  (tax_agreement_exclusively_among_credit_parties Bool) ; True if the tax sharing, allocation or similar agreement is exclusively between or among the Credit Parties.
) Bool
  (=> (and on_or_after_effective_date (not commitments_terminated_and_obligations_paid))
    (and
      ; Clause (i): restricted Permitted Subordinated Debt payments, unless permitted by proviso (A) or (B)
      (=> sub_debt_payment_made
        (and is_magellan_redemption_or_repurchase
          (or
            (and (not default_exists_or_would_result)
                 (<= fiscal_year_redemption_total 10000000.0))
            (and (not default_exists_or_would_result)
                 pro_forma_9_08_compliant
                 (<= pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio 1.5)
                 (>= (+ total_unutilized_revolving_commitment unrestricted_cash_and_equivalents) 75000000.0)
                 officer_certificate_delivered))))
      ; Clause (ii): amendments of Permitted Subordinated Debt Documents
      (=> (and sub_debt_document_executed amends_sub_debt_document)
        (and
          (or amendment_less_restrictive
              amendment_reduces_rates_or_fees
              amendment_extends_maturity
              amendment_reduces_prepayment_premiums
              amendment_not_materially_adverse_per_agent)
          (or (not amends_subordination_provisions)
              agent_prior_written_consent_subordination)))
      ; Clause (iii): organizational and equity document changes
      (=> amends_org_or_equity_documents
        org_or_equity_change_not_materially_adverse)
      ; Clause (iv): tax sharing agreements
      (=> amends_or_enters_tax_sharing_agreement
        (or agent_prior_written_consent_tax
            tax_agreement_exclusively_among_credit_parties)))))

                            (ebitda Real)
                            (rental_expense Real)
                            (capex Real)
                            (interest_expense Real)
                            (loans_outstanding Real)

; total_contract_balance_remaining: aggregate Contract Balance Remaining for all Leases in the Managed Portfolio, as determined on the observation date.
; defaulted_net_investment_12m: aggregate GAAP net investment for all Managed Portfolio Leases that were Defaulted Leases (under clause (a) or (c) of the definition) as of the observation date or became Defaulted Leases (under clause (b)) during the twelve-month period then ended.

; static_pool_loss_ratio_recent: Static Pool Loss Ratio for the Managed Portfolio for Leases originated or acquired during the twelve-month period ending on the last day of the calendar quarter, as a fraction (0.025 = 2.5%).
; static_pool_loss_ratio_13_24: Static Pool Loss Ratio for the Managed Portfolio for Leases originated or acquired during the thirteenth through twenty-fourth month period preceding the last day of the calendar quarter, as a fraction.

(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_month_end Bool)
    (is_quarter_end Bool)
    (is_on_or_after_2009_12_31 Bool)
    (delinquent_contract_balance_remaining Real)
    (total_contract_balance_remaining Real)
    (defaulted_net_investment_12m Real)
    (average_monthly_net_investment_12m Real)
    (static_pool_loss_ratio_recent Real)
    (static_pool_loss_ratio_13_24 Real)
    (static_pool_loss_ratio_older Real)) Bool

        (<= (/ delinquent_contract_balance_remaining total_contract_balance_remaining) 0.035))
    ; 7.19(b): default/charge-off ratio must not exceed 7.0% on month-ends on or after 12/31/2009

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the date as of which all four ratios are determined.
; ebitda: EBITDA for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date (pro forma for Permitted Acquisitions as the source describes).
; capital_expenditures: Capital Expenditures for the same four-quarter period.
; interest_expense: Interest Expense for the same four-quarter period, used in the fixed charge denominator.
; sched_amort_term_loans: scheduled amortization of the principal portion of the Term Loans for the period.
; sched_amort_other_debt: scheduled amortization of the principal portion of all other Indebtedness for borrowed money of the Borrower for the period.
; cash_taxes_paid: cash taxes paid by the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries for the period.
; restricted_payments: Restricted Payments made during the period, excluding Acquisition Redemptions and Restricted Payments made pursuant to CLAUSE (III) of SECTION 7.3(F).
; customer_loan_guaranty_payments: payments made by the Borrower or any Subsidiary, directly or indirectly, under any Customer Loan Guaranties during the period.
; customer_lease_guaranty_payments: payments made by the Borrower or any Subsidiary, directly or indirectly, under any Customer Lease Guaranties during the period.
; total_debt: Total Debt as of the last day of the fiscal quarter.
; rentals: Rentals for the four-quarter period ending on the observation date.
; cash_interest_expense: cash Interest Expense for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date.
; lev_band1: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through March 31, 2001, which is the first band of the Leverage and Lease Adjusted Leverage tables.
; lev_band2: true iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2001 through March 31, 2002.
; lev_band3: true iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2002 through March 31, 2003.
; lev_band4: true iff the quarter end falls in "each quarter thereafter", meaning after March 31, 2003.
; ice_band1: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through December 31, 1999.
; ice_band2: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 2000 through December 31, 2000.
; ice_band3: true iff the quarter end is a fiscal quarter after December 31, 2000.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (ebitda Real)
    (capital_expenditures Real)
    (interest_expense Real)
    (sched_amort_term_loans Real)
    (sched_amort_other_debt Real)
    (cash_taxes_paid Real)
    (restricted_payments Real)
    (customer_loan_guaranty_payments Real)
    (customer_lease_guaranty_payments Real)
    (total_debt Real)
    (rentals Real)
    (cash_interest_expense Real)
    (lev_band1 Bool)
    (lev_band2 Bool)
    (lev_band3 Bool)
    (lev_band4 Bool)
    (ice_band1 Bool)
    (ice_band2 Bool)
    (ice_band3 Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; (A) Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of at least 1.10 to 1.00
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= (/ (- ebitda capital_expenditures)
               (+ interest_expense sched_amort_term_loans sched_amort_other_debt
                  cash_taxes_paid restricted_payments
                  customer_loan_guaranty_payments customer_lease_guaranty_payments))
            1.10))
    ; (B) Maximum Leverage Ratio: Total Debt / EBITDA must not be greater than the band limit
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band1) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 4.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band2) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 3.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band3) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 3.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band4) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 2.50))
    ; (C) Maximum Lease Adjusted Leverage Ratio: (Total Debt + 8 * Rentals) / (EBITDA + Rentals)
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band1)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 5.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band2)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 4.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band3)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 4.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band4)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 3.75))
    ; (D) Interest Expense Coverage Ratio: EBITDA / cash Interest Expense of at least the band minimum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band1) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 2.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band2) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 3.25))

(define-fun covenant_holds (

    (any_advance_or_obligation_unpaid Bool)
    (any_letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
    (any_lender_commitment_exists Bool)

               any_letter_of_credit_outstanding

           (>= consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio 4.0))))

Translate the real financial covenant into SMT-LIB2, not borrower-compliance QA. Return exactly a set-logic command (QF_LRA or QF_NRA) and one (define-fun covenant_holds ((parameter Real_or_Bool) ...) Bool body). Use meaningful parameters and comments giving precise source-grounded meanings. Use only arithmetic, comparisons, Boolean connectives and ite. We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.
For example, a quarterly maximum leverage requirement uses a Real leverage_ratio parameter and a Bool is_quarter_end parameter, with body (=> is_quarter_end (<= leverage_ratio 3.5)). (set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; q_end_in_closing_to_2004_06_30: true iff the fiscal quarter ends during the period from the Closing Date to and including June 30, 2004.
; q_end_in_2004_09_30_to_2005_06_30: true iff the fiscal quarter ends during the period from September 30, 2004 to June 30, 2005.
; q_end_on_or_after_2005_09_30: true iff the fiscal quarter ends on or after September 30, 2005.
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the end of the fiscal quarter, as a plain number (3.75 means 3.75 to 1.0).
; consolidated_fccr: Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the end of the fiscal quarter, as a plain number (1.15 means 1.15:1.0).
; q_end_is_2003_09_30: true iff the fiscal quarter ends on September 30, 2003.
; q_end_is_2003_12_31: true iff the fiscal quarter ends on December 31, 2003.
; q_end_is_2004_03_31: true iff the fiscal quarter ends on March 31, 2004.
; q_end_on_or_after_2004_06_30: true iff the fiscal quarter ends on June 30, 2004 or thereafter.
; consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters: Consolidated EBITDA in US dollars for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending at the observed quarter end.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (q_end_in_closing_to_2004_06_30 Bool)
    (q_end_in_2004_09_30_to_2005_06_30 Bool)
    (q_end_on_or_after_2005_09_30 Bool)
    (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
    (consolidated_fccr Real)
    (q_end_is_2003_09_30 Bool)
    (q_end_is_2003_12_31 Bool)
    (q_end_is_2004_03_31 Bool)
    (q_end_on_or_after_2004_06_30 Bool)
    (consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters Real)
  ) Bool
  (and
    ; 8.11(a) maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio, not greater than the applicable limit
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end q_end_in_closing_to_2004_06_30)
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end q_end_in_2004_09_30_to_2005_06_30)
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.5))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end q_end_on_or_after_2005_09_30)
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.25))
    ; 8.11(b) minimum Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, not less than 1.15
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= consolidated_fccr 1.15))
    ; 8.11(c) minimum Consolidated EBITDA, not less than the amount for the quarter
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end q_end_is_2003_09_30)
        (>= consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters 37000000.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end q_end_is_2003_12_31)
        (>= consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters 37000000.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end q_end_is_2004_03_31)
        (>= consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters 40000000.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end q_end_on_or_after_2004_06_30)
        (>= consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters 40000000.0))
  )
)

; loans_outstanding: True if any Loans are outstanding under the Revolving Credit and/or the Term Credit at the observation time.
; observation_before_dec_1_1999: True if the observation time is prior to December 1, 1999.
; obligations_not_paid_in_full: True if not all obligations of the Borrower under the Agreement have been paid in full at the observation time.

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter, the date at which Section 4.9(a)-(d) ratios are tested.
; is_on_or_after_first_test_period: true iff the observed fiscal-quarter period ends on or after March 31, 1997, the first period for which compliance is determined.
; total_current_assets: Investors' total current assets (GAAP, consistently applied) at the quarter-end observation.
; total_current_liabilities: Investors' total current liabilities (GAAP, consistently applied) at the quarter-end observation.
; ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter: EBITDA for the twelve-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; interest_expense_ttm_prior_quarter: total interest expense deducted in determining net income for the twelve-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; current_maturities_principal_prior_quarter: all current maturities of principal on all unsubordinated long-term indebtedness of Borrowers, excluding any amount outstanding under the Line of Credit, as of the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; senior_funded_debt: Senior Funded Debt, i.e. total funded unsubordinated indebtedness of Borrowers per GAAP, including capital leases.
; term_loan_made: true iff the Term Loan has been made as of the observation (true = from and after the making of the Term Loan; false = prior to it).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (is_on_or_after_first_test_period Bool)
    (total_current_assets Real)
    (total_current_liabilities Real)
    (ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter Real)
    (interest_expense_ttm_prior_quarter Real)
    (current_maturities_principal_prior_quarter Real)
    (senior_funded_debt Real)
    (term_loan_made Bool)) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_on_or_after_first_test_period)
      (and
        ; (a) Current Ratio >= 1.20
        (>= (/ total_current_assets total_current_liabilities) 1.2)
        ; (b) Debt Service Coverage Ratio >= 1.5
        (>= (/ ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter
               (+ interest_expense_ttm_prior_quarter current_maturities_principal_prior_quarter))
            1.5)
        ; (c) before Term Loan: Senior Funded Debt / EBITDA <= 5.0; (d) from and after Term Loan: <= 3.5
        (ite term_loan_made
             (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter) 3.5)
             (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter) 5.0)))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; funded_debt_to_cap_ratio: Consolidated Funded Debt to Capitalization Ratio as of the observation date (atomic ratio, to 1.0).
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the observation date (atomic ratio, to 1.0).
; investment_grade_date_occurred: true iff the observation date is on or after the Investment Grade Date.
; consolidated_funded_debt: Consolidated Funded Debt at the observation date.
; consolidated_ebitda_midstream_ltm: Consolidated EBITDA-Midstream for the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date, or ending on the last day of the most recently ended fiscal quarter if the date is not a quarter end.
; present_value: the Present Value amount at the observation date, as used in Section 7.11(c)(2).
; debt_ratings_trigger_period_active: true iff the observation date falls within a Debt Ratings Trigger Period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (funded_debt_to_cap_ratio Real)
    (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
    (investment_grade_date_occurred Bool)
    (consolidated_funded_debt Real)
    (consolidated_ebitda_midstream_ltm Real)
    (present_value Real)
    (debt_ratings_trigger_period_active Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; 7.11(a): at each fiscal quarter end, ratio must not exceed 0.6
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= funded_debt_to_cap_ratio 0.6))
    ; 7.11(b): at each fiscal quarter end, leverage ratio must not exceed 3.5, ceasing from the Investment Grade Date
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end (not investment_grade_date_occurred))
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.5))
    ; 7.11(c): only during a Debt Ratings Trigger Period, debt <= 3.5 * EBITDA-Midstream + Present Value / 1.50
    (=> debt_ratings_trigger_period_active
        (<= consolidated_funded_debt
            (+ (* 3.5 consolidated_ebitda_midstream_ltm) (/ present_value 1.50))))))

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_on_or_after_spin_out_effective_date)
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 2.0))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)

; bank_has_commitment: true if any Bank has any Commitment under the Agreement at the observation time.
; lessee_obligation_exists: true if a Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries creates, incurs, assumes or suffers to exist an obligation as lessee for the rental or hire of real or personal property (the lease under test) at the observation time.
; is_existing_schedule_lease_or_renewal: true if the lease is an existing lease on the date of the Agreement set forth on Schedule 7.4, or an extension or renewal of one.
; is_capital_lease: true if the lease is a Capital Lease.
; fccr_not_violated_pro_forma: true if the lease does not result in a violation of the Section 8.4 Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, measured on a combined basis for the immediately preceding four fiscal quarters (Reference Period), with pro forma effect as if the lease had been incurred on the first day of the Reference Period.
; annual_lease_payments_usd: annual payments under the lease, in dollars.
; calc_bases_provided_to_agent: true if the bases of the Section 7.4(b) calculation have been provided to the Agent.
; agent_written_consent_issued: true if the Agent has issued its written consent to the lease.
; is_intragroup_lease: true if the lease is between a Borrower and a Subsidiary, or between Subsidiaries.
; capital_lease_permitted_by_7_3: true if the lease is a Capital Lease permitted by Section 7.3.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (notes_remain_unpaid Bool)
  (bank_has_commitment Bool)
  (lessee_obligation_exists Bool)
  (is_existing_schedule_lease_or_renewal Bool)
  (is_capital_lease Bool)
  (fccr_not_violated_pro_forma Bool)
  (annual_lease_payments_usd Real)
  (calc_bases_provided_to_agent Bool)
  (agent_written_consent_issued Bool)
  (is_intragroup_lease Bool)
  (capital_lease_permitted_by_7_3 Bool)) Bool
  (=> (and (or notes_remain_unpaid bank_has_commitment) lessee_obligation_exists)
      (or is_existing_schedule_lease_or_renewal
          (and (not is_capital_lease)
               fccr_not_violated_pro_forma
               (=> (> annual_lease_payments_usd 50000.0)
                   (and calc_bases_provided_to_agent agent_written_consent_issued)))
          is_intragroup_lease
          (and is_capital_lease capital_lease_permitted_by_7_3))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; revolving_note_unpaid: the Revolving Credit Note remains unpaid at the observation time.
; bank_has_commitment: the Bank has a Commitment under the Agreement at the observation time.
; acquisition_made: the Borrower and/or Guarantor makes an Acquisition at this observation.
; prior_written_consent: the Bank gave prior written consent to this Acquisition.
; acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets: the acquisition is of stock or assets (excluding real property) of another person or entity.
; borrower_is_surviving_entity: the Borrower is the surviving entity.
; same_line_of_business: the acquiree (or the acquired assets' use) is in the same general line of business as the Borrower and the Guarantor.
; acquiree_us_organized: the acquiree is incorporated or organized in the United States.
; acquisition_non_hostile: the acquisition is non-hostile in nature.
; no_default_before: prior to the acquisition there is no Default or Event of Default under the Agreement.
; no_default_after: immediately following the acquisition there is no Default or Event of Default under the Agreement.
; third_party_consents_obtained: all third party consents and approvals necessary for the acquisition have been obtained.
; free_clear_evidence_ok: evidence exists that the stock or assets are purchased free and clear of liens/encumbrances other than those permitted under the Agreement and, for stock, free of restrictions other than those acceptable to the Bank.
; acquiree_becomes_subsidiary: the proposed acquiree becomes a Subsidiary of the Borrower.
; bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues: the Bank and its counsel are satisfied with all issues relating to consideration for the entity to guaranty and pledge all of its assets as Collateral.
; sub_guarantee_delivered: the Subsidiary immediately executed and delivered its Guarantee of the Borrower's Revolving Credit Commitment obligations, in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank and its counsel.
; sub_pledge_delivered: the Subsidiary immediately pledged all its assets as Collateral and executed all documentation required by the Bank to perfect a first priority security interest, satisfactory to the Bank and its counsel.
; environmental_compliance_evidence: evidence exists that the acquiree complies with all environmental, federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations for all real estate to be acquired by the Borrower.
; aggregate_consideration: aggregate Consideration in dollars paid by the Borrower for this and all prior acquisitions during the term of the Agreement.
; bank_received_documentation: prior to consummation, the Bank received, for satisfactory review and approval, all documentation required by the Bank for the Acceptable Acquisition (clause (i)).
; other_info_received: prior to consummation, the Bank received such other information, documentation or certificates as it reasonably requested, satisfactory in form and substance (clause (iii)).
; liabilities_before: Consolidated Total Liabilities (including non-perpetual preferred stock) of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries before the acquisition.
; liabilities_after: Consolidated Total Liabilities (including non-perpetual preferred stock) of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries after the acquisition.
; total_assets_after: Consolidated Total Assets of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries after the acquisition.
; buyout_liabilities_after: portion of Consolidated Total Liabilities after the acquisition derived from past or present buyouts, acquisitions or recapitalizations.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (revolving_note_unpaid Bool)
  (bank_has_commitment Bool)
  (acquisition_made Bool)
  (prior_written_consent Bool)
  (acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets Bool)
  (borrower_is_surviving_entity Bool)
  (same_line_of_business Bool)
  (acquiree_us_organized Bool)
  (acquisition_non_hostile Bool)
  (no_default_before Bool)
  (no_default_after Bool)
  (third_party_consents_obtained Bool)
  (free_clear_evidence_ok Bool)
  (acquiree_becomes_subsidiary Bool)
  (bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues Bool)
  (sub_guarantee_delivered Bool)
  (sub_pledge_delivered Bool)
  (environmental_compliance_evidence Bool)
  (aggregate_consideration Real)
  (bank_received_documentation Bool)
  (other_info_received Bool)
  (liabilities_before Real)
  (liabilities_after Real)
  (total_assets_after Real)
  (buyout_liabilities_after Real)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or revolving_note_unpaid bank_has_commitment) acquisition_made)
      (or prior_written_consent
          (and acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets
               borrower_is_surviving_entity
               same_line_of_business
               acquiree_us_organized
               acquisition_non_hostile
               no_default_before
               no_default_after
               third_party_consents_obtained
               free_clear_evidence_ok
               (=> acquiree_becomes_subsidiary
                   (and bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues
                        sub_guarantee_delivered
                        sub_pledge_delivered))
               environmental_compliance_evidence
               (<= aggregate_consideration 2000000.0)
               bank_received_documentation
               (or (and (< liabilities_after (* 2.0 liabilities_before))
                        (<= (/ liabilities_after total_assets_after) 0.5))
                   (and (<= (/ liabilities_after total_assets_after) 0.75)
                        (< (/ buyout_liabilities_after liabilities_after) 0.25)))
               other_info_received))))

           (not (> consolidated_leverage_ratio 2.5)))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; in_stage_2: observation falls during Stage 2.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter.
; on_or_after_q_2003_03_31: the Fiscal Quarter ending at this observation is the quarter ending March 31, 2003 or a later one.
; on_or_after_q_2003_12_31: the Fiscal Quarter ending at this observation is the quarter ending December 31, 2003 or a later one.
; before_initial_funding_date: observation is at a time prior to the Initial Funding Date.
; is_last_fq_before_initial_funding: the quarter ending at this observation is the Fiscal Quarter most recently ended prior to the Initial Funding Date.
; senior_leverage_ratio: Senior Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; max_senior_leverage_ratio: maximum Senior Leverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(a) for that Fiscal Quarter.
; total_leverage_ratio: Total Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; max_total_leverage_ratio: maximum Total Leverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(b) for that Fiscal Quarter.
; interest_coverage_ratio: Interest Coverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; min_interest_coverage_ratio: minimum Interest Coverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(c) for that Fiscal Quarter.
; pro_forma_dscr: Pro Forma Debt Service Coverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; min_pro_forma_dscr: minimum Pro Forma Debt Service Coverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(d) for that Fiscal Quarter.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((in_stage_2 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (on_or_after_q_2003_03_31 Bool)
                            (on_or_after_q_2003_12_31 Bool)
                            (before_initial_funding_date Bool)
                            (is_last_fq_before_initial_funding Bool)
                            (senior_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (max_senior_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (total_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (max_total_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (interest_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (min_interest_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (pro_forma_dscr Real)
                            (min_pro_forma_dscr Real)) Bool
  (=> (and in_stage_2
           is_fiscal_quarter_end
           (not (and before_initial_funding_date (not is_last_fq_before_initial_funding))))
      (and (=> on_or_after_q_2003_03_31
               (and (<= senior_leverage_ratio max_senior_leverage_ratio)
                    (<= total_leverage_ratio max_total_leverage_ratio)
                    (>= interest_coverage_ratio min_interest_coverage_ratio)))
           (=> on_or_after_q_2003_12_31
               (>= pro_forma_dscr min_pro_forma_dscr)))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; obligation_outstanding: true iff any Advance remains unpaid or any Lender has any Commitment at the observation time.
; required_lenders_consent: true iff the Required Lenders have consented in writing to non-compliance with clauses (a) and (b) at the observation time.
; supermajority_lenders_consent: true iff the Supermajority Lenders have consented in writing to non-compliance with clause (c) at the observation time.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter.
; ocf_current_quarter: Consolidated Operating Cash Flow for the current fiscal quarter.
; ocf_prior_quarter: Consolidated Operating Cash Flow for the fiscal quarter immediately preceding the current fiscal quarter.
; consolidated_debt_service: Consolidated Debt Service used as the denominator in clause (a).
; consolidated_debt: Consolidated Debt at the observation time, in US dollars.
; ocf_two_quarters_certificate: Consolidated Operating Cash Flow for the two fiscal quarters set forth in the most recent Compliance Certificate delivered by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent (sum over the two quarters, before multiplication by two).
; on_or_after_initial_borrowing: true iff the observation date is on or after the date of the Initial Borrowing.
; on_or_before_march_31_1995: true iff the observation date is on or before March 31, 1995.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((obligation_outstanding Bool)
                            (required_lenders_consent Bool)
                            (supermajority_lenders_consent Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (ocf_current_quarter Real)
                            (ocf_prior_quarter Real)
                            (consolidated_debt_service Real)
                            (consolidated_debt Real)
                            (ocf_two_quarters_certificate Real)
                            (on_or_after_initial_borrowing Bool)
                            (on_or_before_march_31_1995 Bool)) Bool
  (=> obligation_outstanding
    (and
      ; (a) at each fiscal quarter end: (current + prior quarter OCF) * 2 / debt service >= 1.15
      (or required_lenders_consent
          (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
              (>= (/ (* 2.0 (+ ocf_current_quarter ocf_prior_quarter)) consolidated_debt_service) 1.15)))
      ; (b) at all times: debt / (two-quarter OCF * 2) <= 6.5 through March 31, 1995 (from Initial Borrowing), <= 6.0 thereafter
      (or required_lenders_consent
          (and
            (=> (and on_or_after_initial_borrowing on_or_before_march_31_1995)
                (<= (/ consolidated_debt (* 2.0 ocf_two_quarters_certificate)) 6.5))
            (=> (not on_or_before_march_31_1995)
                (<= (/ consolidated_debt (* 2.0 ocf_two_quarters_certificate)) 6.0))))
      ; (c) at any time: Consolidated Debt must not exceed $2,000,000,000
      (or supermajority_lenders_consent
          (<= consolidated_debt 2000000000.0)))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; obligations_outstanding: true if any Note or other amount due under the agreement is outstanding and unpaid at the observation time.
; total_indebtedness_excl_lc: Total Indebtedness on the observation date, excluding all letters of credit (Section 6.01(1) numerator).
; total_indebtedness_incl_lc: Total Indebtedness on the observation date, including letters of credit other than those issued under Section 2.02 (Section 6.01(2) numerator).
; ebitdar_review_period: EBITDAR of the Borrower for the four consecutive fiscal quarters most recently ended on or before the determination date (Review Period).
; acquired_ebitdar: Without duplication, EBITDAR of any Person acquired by the Borrower or any Subsidiary (purchase, merger, consolidation or otherwise) for each fiscal quarter or portion thereof from twelve months before the determination date to the acquisition date. Use 0 if none.
; ebit_4q: EBIT for the four consecutive quarters ended on or before the observation date.
; interest_expense_4q: Interest Expense for the same four consecutive quarters ended on or before the observation date.
; tangible_net_worth: Tangible Net Worth at the observation time.
; positive_net_income_sum: Sum, over each fiscal quarter commencing with the quarter ended September 30, 2002 up to the observation time, of that quarter's Net Income if positive (zero for a quarter with non-positive Net Income). This is before applying the 75%.
; equity_net_proceeds_sum: Sum of Net Proceeds from the issuance and sale of equity securities after the date of the agreement, up to the observation time. This is before applying the 75%.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_outstanding Bool)
  (total_indebtedness_excl_lc Real)
  (total_indebtedness_incl_lc Real)
  (ebitdar_review_period Real)
  (acquired_ebitdar Real)
  (ebit_4q Real)
  (interest_expense_4q Real)
  (tangible_net_worth Real)
  (positive_net_income_sum Real)
  (equity_net_proceeds_sum Real)) Bool
  (=> obligations_outstanding
    (and
      ; 6.01(1): ratio must not be greater than 2.75 to 1.0
      (<= (/ total_indebtedness_excl_lc (+ ebitdar_review_period acquired_ebitdar)) 2.75)
      ; 6.01(2): ratio must not be greater than 3.00 to 1.0
      (<= (/ total_indebtedness_incl_lc (+ ebitdar_review_period acquired_ebitdar)) 3.0)
      ; 6.01(3): ratio must not be less than 1.75 to 1.00
      (>= (/ ebit_4q interest_expense_4q) 1.75)
      ; 6.01(4): Tangible Net Worth must not be less than the floor
      (>= tangible_net_worth
          (+ 113000000.0 (* 0.75 positive_net_income_sum) (* 0.75 equity_net_proceeds_sum))))))

; cofc_tangible_net_worth: COFC Tangible Net Worth as of the observation (determination) date, in the agreement currency.
; cofc_tnw_march_31_2004: COFC Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004, in the agreement currency.
; cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end: COFC Cumulative Net Income as of the last day of the COFC fiscal quarter most recently ended after March 31, 2004 (relative to the observation date).
; cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds: COFC Cumulative Equity Proceeds as of the observation (determination) date.
; double_leverage_ratio: Double Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, expressed as X in "X to 1" (1.25 to 1 = 1.25).
; is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a COB fiscal quarter.
; cob_tier1_leverage_ratio: COB Tier 1 Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (5.0% = 0.05).
; is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of an FSB fiscal quarter.
; fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio: FSB Tier 1 Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (5.0% = 0.05).
; cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: COB Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).
; fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: FSB Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).
; cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: COB Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).
; fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: FSB Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).

; cobe_tnw_march_31_2004: COBE Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004, in Dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (any_commitment_or_loan_outstanding Bool)
    (payment_in_full_occurred Bool)
    (is_calendar_month_end Bool)
    (delinquency_ratio Real)
    (is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio Real)
    (cofc_tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cofc_tnw_march_31_2004 Real)
    (cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end Real)
    (cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds Real)
    (double_leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (cob_tier1_leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio Real)
    (cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate Real)
    (cobe_tnw_march_31_2004 Real)) Bool

      (and
        ; (a) Delinquency Ratio must not exceed 6.0% at calendar month end
        (=> is_calendar_month_end (<= delinquency_ratio 0.06))
        ; (b) Tier 1 Capital to Managed Receivables Ratio must not be less than 4.0% at COFC fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end (>= tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio 0.04))
        ; (c) COFC Tangible Net Worth on any date must not be less than the stated sum
        (>= cofc_tangible_net_worth
            (+ (* 0.75 cofc_tnw_march_31_2004)
               (* 0.6 cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end)
               (* 0.6 cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds)))
        ; (d) Double Leverage Ratio must not exceed 1.25 to 1 at COFC fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end (<= double_leverage_ratio 1.25))
        ; (e) Tier 1 Leverage Ratio not less than 5.0% for COB and FSB at their fiscal quarter ends
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_tier1_leverage_ratio 0.05))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio 0.05))
        ; (f) Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio not less than 6.0% for COB and FSB
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.06))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.06))
        ; (g) Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio not less than 10.0% for COB and FSB
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.10))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.10))
        ; (h) COBE Tangible Net Worth (in Dollars at March 31, 2004 rate) on any date not less than 75% of its March 31, 2004 Tangible Net Worth
        (>= cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate (* 0.75 cobe_tnw_march_31_2004)))))

; interest_expense_raw: unannualized Interest Expense (consolidated) for the four fiscal quarters then ended, or for the full fiscal quarters elapsed since the Closing Date if fewer than four have elapsed.
; fixed_charges_raw: unannualized Fixed Charges (consolidated) for the four fiscal quarters then ended, or for the full fiscal quarters elapsed since the Closing Date if fewer than four have elapsed.
; consolidated_total_indebtedness: Consolidated Total Indebtedness as of the observation day.
; capitalization_value: Capitalization Value as of the observation day.
; unencumbered_assets_value: Value of Unencumbered Assets as of the observation day.

; consolidated_secured_indebtedness: Consolidated Secured Indebtedness as of the observation day.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (is_through_dec_31_1999 Bool)
    (fewer_than_four_full_quarters Bool)
    (full_quarters_elapsed Real)
    (ebitda Real)
    (interest_expense_raw Real)
    (fixed_charges_raw Real)
    (consolidated_total_indebtedness Real)
    (capitalization_value Real)
    (unencumbered_assets_value Real)
    (consolidated_unsecured_indebtedness Real)
    (consolidated_secured_indebtedness Real)) Bool

    ; (i) EBITDA / Interest Expense must not be less than 2.5 (through 12/31/1999) or 2.75 (thereafter)
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= (/ ebitda
               (ite fewer_than_four_full_quarters
                    (/ (* 4.0 interest_expense_raw) full_quarters_elapsed)
                    interest_expense_raw))
            (ite is_through_dec_31_1999 2.5 2.75)))
    ; (ii) EBITDA / Fixed Charges must not be less than 1.85 (through 12/31/1999) or 2.0 (thereafter)

                    fixed_charges_raw))

    (<= consolidated_total_indebtedness (* 0.5 capitalization_value))
    ; (iv) Unencumbered Assets value must not be less than 2.0 times Consolidated Unsecured Indebtedness
    (>= unencumbered_assets_value (* 2.0 consolidated_unsecured_indebtedness))
    ; (v) Consolidated Secured Indebtedness must not exceed 20% of Capitalization Value
    (<= consolidated_secured_indebtedness (* 0.2 capitalization_value))))

(define-fun covenant_holds ((consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (consolidated_total_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_ending_on_or_after_2016_06_30 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_ending_2016_06_30_to_2016_12_31 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_ending_on_or_after_2017_03_31 Bool)) Bool

        (<= consolidated_total_leverage_ratio 3.75))))

  (=> (and covenant_in_effect (not required_lenders_consented))
      (and (=> period_ends_2001_window (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.25))
           (=> period_ends_2002 (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.5))
           (=> period_ends_2003 (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.75))
           (=> period_ends_2004_onward (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.0)))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_on_or_after_effective_date: true iff the observation date is on or after the Effective Date.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; is_at_or_after_first_full_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is on or after the first full fiscal quarter-end date occurring after the Effective Date.
; lender_has_commitment: true iff any Lender has any Commitment outstanding under the agreement at the observation.
; obligation_unpaid_or_unsatisfied: true iff any Revolving Loan or other Obligation remains unpaid or unsatisfied, excluding contingent indemnification obligations for which no claim has been made.
; consolidated_debt: Consolidated Debt of the Borrower as of the observation date (currency units).
; total_capitalization: Total Capitalization as of the observation date (currency units, same as consolidated_debt).
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_on_or_after_effective_date Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (is_at_or_after_first_full_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (lender_has_commitment Bool)
                            (obligation_unpaid_or_unsatisfied Bool)
                            (consolidated_debt Real)
                            (total_capitalization Real)) Bool
  (=> (and is_on_or_after_effective_date
           (or lender_has_commitment obligation_unpaid_or_unsatisfied)
           is_fiscal_quarter_end
           is_at_or_after_first_full_fiscal_quarter_end)
      (<= (/ consolidated_debt total_capitalization) 0.60)))

; lacks_two_investment_grade_ratings: true iff the Company does not have outstanding Index Debt that is investment grade rated by two of Moody's, S&P and Fitch.

; pro_forma_leverage_ratio: the Leverage Ratio on a pro forma basis after giving effect to the transaction, as if it had occurred at the beginning of any relevant quarter, as a ratio to 1.0.
; is_loan_advance_or_other_investment: true iff the transaction is a loan, advance or other investment (not solely a capital contribution), so the arm's length condition (i) applies.

; default_continuing_at_time: true iff a Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing at the time of making the transaction.
; default_would_occur_after_effect: true iff a Default or Event of Default would occur after giving effect to the transaction.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (makes_unrestricted_sub_investment Bool)
    (lacks_two_investment_grade_ratings Bool)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (pro_forma_leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_loan_advance_or_other_investment Bool)
    (arm_length_terms Bool)
    (default_continuing_at_time Bool)
    (default_would_occur_after_effect Bool)

           lacks_two_investment_grade_ratings
           (or (> leverage_ratio 5.5) (> pro_forma_leverage_ratio 5.5)))
      (and (=> is_loan_advance_or_other_investment arm_length_terms)
           (not default_continuing_at_time)
           (not default_would_occur_after_effect))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; advance_unpaid: true if any Advance remains unpaid at the observation.
; letter_of_credit_outstanding: true if any Letter of Credit is outstanding at the observation.
; lender_has_commitment: true if any Lender has any Commitment under the agreement at the observation.
; is_measurement_date: true if the observation date is the last day of a full fiscal quarter of the Borrower ending after the Effective Date (a Measurement Date).
; is_first_six_full_quarters: true if the Measurement Date is the last day of one of the first six full fiscal quarters following the Effective Date.
; consolidated_total_debt: Consolidated Total Debt as of the Measurement Date.
; consolidated_rental_expense: Consolidated Rental Expense for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the Measurement Date.
; consolidated_ebitdar: Consolidated EBITDAR for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the Measurement Date.
; consolidated_interest_expense: Consolidated Interest Expense for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the Measurement Date.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((advance_unpaid Bool)
                            (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
                            (lender_has_commitment Bool)
                            (is_measurement_date Bool)
                            (is_first_six_full_quarters Bool)
                            (consolidated_total_debt Real)
                            (consolidated_rental_expense Real)
                            (consolidated_ebitdar Real)
                            (consolidated_interest_expense Real)) Bool
  (=> (and (or advance_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding lender_has_commitment)
           is_measurement_date)
      (and
        ; (a) Leverage Ratio: (debt + 6 * rental) / EBITDAR <= 3.75 for first six quarters, else 3.5
        (<= (/ (+ consolidated_total_debt (* 6.0 consolidated_rental_expense))
               consolidated_ebitdar)
            (ite is_first_six_full_quarters 3.75 3.5))
        ; (b) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio: EBITDAR / (interest + rental) >= 2.0
        (>= (/ consolidated_ebitdar
               (+ consolidated_interest_expense consolidated_rental_expense))
            2.0))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)

; first_priority_inventory: Holdings' consolidated inventories subject to a first priority perfected security interest in favor of the Collateral Agent under the Guarantee and Collateral Agreement, at the observation date (currency units).
; inventory_secured_6_02_f: then outstanding amounts secured by a security interest on inventory permitted by Section 6.02(f), at the observation date (currency units); excluded from the inventory term.
; consolidated_funded_indebtedness: Consolidated Funded Indebtedness at the observation date (currency units); the ratio denominator.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a Fiscal Quarter.
; is_quarter_ending_2005_09_30: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ending at the observation is the quarter ending 9/30/05.
; is_quarter_ending_2005_12_31: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ending at the observation is the quarter ending 12/31/05.
; is_quarter_ending_2006_03_31: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ending at the observation is the quarter ending 3/31/06.
; is_quarter_ending_2006_06_30_or_later: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ending at the observation is the quarter ending 6/30/06 or any later quarter.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (accounts_receivable Real)
  (first_priority_inventory Real)
  (inventory_secured_6_02_f Real)
  (consolidated_funded_indebtedness Real)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_quarter_ending_2005_09_30 Bool)
  (is_quarter_ending_2005_12_31 Bool)
  (is_quarter_ending_2006_03_31 Bool)
  (is_quarter_ending_2006_06_30_or_later Bool)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      (=> is_quarter_ending_2005_09_30
        (>= (/ (- (+ accounts_receivable first_priority_inventory) inventory_secured_6_02_f) consolidated_funded_indebtedness) 1.20))
      (=> is_quarter_ending_2005_12_31
        (>= (/ (- (+ accounts_receivable first_priority_inventory) inventory_secured_6_02_f) consolidated_funded_indebtedness) 1.20))
      (=> is_quarter_ending_2006_03_31

      (=> is_quarter_ending_2006_06_30_or_later
        (>= (/ (- (+ accounts_receivable first_priority_inventory) inventory_secured_6_02_f) consolidated_funded_indebtedness) 1.25)))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)

; leverage_ratio: the Leverage Ratio as of the observation date (atomic Real, definition not supplied).
; is_quarter_closing_date_through_2014: true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the observation date is within the period from the Closing Date through and including December 31, 2014.
; is_quarter_march_2015_or_later: true iff the fiscal quarter ends on March 31, 2015 or later.
; acquisition_consideration_usd: consideration in US dollars for the individual Permitted Acquisition that gives rise to the Adjusted Leverage Ratio window covering this quarter.
; prior_notice_given_5_business_days: true iff the Borrowers gave prior written notice to the Administrative Agent at least five Business Days before that Acquisition.
; in_adjusted_four_quarter_window: true iff this fiscal quarter is one of the four fiscal quarters beginning with the quarter in which that Permitted Acquisition occurs.
; pro_forma_compliant_with_adjusted_ratio: true iff the Company is in compliance on a Pro Forma Basis with the Adjusted Leverage Ratio after giving effect to that Permitted Acquisition.
; adjusted_ratio_reuse_permitted: true iff the Adjusted Leverage Ratio is not barred by an earlier application, meaning either no earlier application or the Company has since complied with the table Leverage Ratio for at least four consecutive fiscal quarters.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (interest_coverage_ratio Real)
    (timberland_coverage_ratio Real)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_quarter_closing_date_through_2014 Bool)
    (is_quarter_march_2015_or_later Bool)
    (acquisition_consideration_usd Real)
    (prior_notice_given_5_business_days Bool)
    (in_adjusted_four_quarter_window Bool)
    (pro_forma_compliant_with_adjusted_ratio Bool)
    (adjusted_ratio_reuse_permitted Bool)
  ) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) Interest Coverage Ratio >= 3.00 at each fiscal quarter end
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.0))
    ; (b) Timberland Coverage Ratio > 3.00 at all times
    (> timberland_coverage_ratio 3.0)
    ; (c) Leverage Ratio max 5.00 through Dec 31, 2014
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_closing_date_through_2014)
        (<= leverage_ratio 5.0))
    ; (c) Leverage Ratio max 4.50 from March 31, 2015, or 5.00 if the Adjusted Leverage Ratio applies
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_march_2015_or_later)
        (<= leverage_ratio
            (ite (and (>= acquisition_consideration_usd 50000000.0)
                      prior_notice_given_5_business_days
                      in_adjusted_four_quarter_window
                      pro_forma_compliant_with_adjusted_ratio
                      adjusted_ratio_reuse_permitted)
                 5.0
                 4.5)))
  )
)

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the period ending at this observation (3-month at 9/30/2005, 6-month at 12/31/2005, 9-month at 3/31/2006, 12-month at 6/30/2006 and each later fiscal quarter end). Atomic ratio; no definition supplied.
; is_sep_30_2005_three_month_test: true iff the observation date is September 30, 2005, the end of the three month FCCR test period.
; is_dec_31_2005_six_month_test: true iff the observation date is December 31, 2005, the end of the six month FCCR test period.
; is_mar_31_2006_nine_month_test: true iff the observation date is March 31, 2006, the end of the nine month FCCR test period.
; is_jun_30_2006_twelve_month_test: true iff the observation date is June 30, 2006, the end of the twelve month FCCR test period.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_jun_30_2006: true iff the observation date is a fiscal quarter end after June 30, 2006, so a twelve month FCCR test period ends there.
; undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week: Undrawn Availability, in dollars, maintained over the rolling two week period ending at this observation.
; undrawn_availability_current: Undrawn Availability, in dollars, at this observation time (the at-all-times floor).
; year_end_2005_financials_received: true iff Borrowers' 2005 year end financial statements have been received by the time of this observation.
; default_or_event_of_default_exists: true iff a Default or an Event of Default exists at this observation.
; consolidated_ebitda: Consolidated EBITDA, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; is_jun_30_2005: true iff the observation date is June 30, 2005.
; is_jul_31_2005: true iff the observation date is July 31, 2005.
; is_aug_31_2005: true iff the observation date is August 31, 2005.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
  (is_sep_30_2005_three_month_test Bool)
  (is_dec_31_2005_six_month_test Bool)
  (is_mar_31_2006_nine_month_test Bool)
  (is_jun_30_2006_twelve_month_test Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_jun_30_2006 Bool)
  (undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week Real)
  (undrawn_availability_current Real)
  (year_end_2005_financials_received Bool)
  (default_or_event_of_default_exists Bool)
  (consolidated_ebitda Real)
  (is_jun_30_2005 Bool)
  (is_jul_31_2005 Bool)
  (is_aug_31_2005 Bool)
) Bool
  (and
    ; (A) FCCR >= 1.05 on each specified test date
    (=> (or is_sep_30_2005_three_month_test
            is_dec_31_2005_six_month_test
            is_mar_31_2006_nine_month_test
            is_jun_30_2006_twelve_month_test
            is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_jun_30_2006)
        (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.05))
    ; (B) before receipt of 2005 year end financials: rolling two week >= 1,000,000 and at all times >= 250,000
    (=> (not year_end_2005_financials_received)
        (and (>= undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week 1000000.0)
             (>= undrawn_availability_current 250000.0)))
    ; (B) thereafter: >= 500,000 provided no Default or Event of Default exists
    (=> (and year_end_2005_financials_received (not default_or_event_of_default_exists))
        (>= undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week 500000.0))
    ; (C) minimum Consolidated EBITDA on the specified dates
    (=> is_jun_30_2005 (>= consolidated_ebitda (- 65000.0)))
    (=> is_jul_31_2005 (>= consolidated_ebitda 80000.0))
    (=> is_aug_31_2005 (>= consolidated_ebitda 90000.0))
  )
)

; obligations_outstanding: true iff, at the observation, Bank remains committed to extend credit to Borrower or any liabilities of Borrower to Bank under the Loan Documents remain outstanding (payment in full not yet made).
; bank_written_consent: true iff Bank has otherwise consented in writing (waiving the Section 4.9 requirements) at the observation.

; on_or_before_1998_02_28: true iff the observation date is on or before 2/28/98.
; on_or_before_1998_05_31: true iff the observation date is on or before 5/31/98.
; on_or_before_1998_08_31: true iff the observation date is on or before 8/31/98.
; on_or_before_1998_11_30: true iff the observation date is on or before FYE 11/30/98.
; on_or_before_1999_05_31: true iff the observation date is on or before 5/31/99.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end of Borrower.
; total_current_assets: consolidated total current assets in dollars.
; total_current_liabilities: consolidated total current liabilities in dollars, including the outstanding principal balance of the Line of Credit.
; total_stockholders_equity: consolidated total stockholders' equity in dollars.
; subordinated_debt: consolidated subordinated debt in dollars.
; intangible_assets: consolidated intangible assets in dollars.
; non_current_liabilities: consolidated non-current liabilities in dollars.
; net_income_after_taxes_quarter: consolidated net income after taxes for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation, in dollars.
; net_profit_before_tax_r4q: consolidated net profit before tax over the rolling four fiscal quarters ending at the observation, in dollars.
; interest_expense_net_capitalized_r4q: interest expense net of capitalized interest expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars.
; depreciation_expense_r4q: depreciation expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars.
; amortization_expense_r4q: amortization expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars.

; funded_debt: all current and non-current interest-bearing liabilities, in dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (obligations_outstanding Bool)
    (bank_written_consent Bool)
    (compliance_commenced Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_02_28 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_05_31 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_08_31 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_11_30 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1999_05_31 Bool)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (total_current_assets Real)
    (total_current_liabilities Real)
    (total_stockholders_equity Real)
    (subordinated_debt Real)
    (intangible_assets Real)
    (non_current_liabilities Real)
    (net_income_after_taxes_quarter Real)
    (net_profit_before_tax_r4q Real)
    (interest_expense_net_capitalized_r4q Real)
    (depreciation_expense_r4q Real)
    (amortization_expense_r4q Real)
    (total_interest_expense_r4q Real)
