Do not emit assert, declare-const, check-sat, or quantifiers.
We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. ; advance_unpaid: true if any Advance remains unpaid at the observation time.
; lender_has_commitment: true if any Lender has any Commitment under the agreement at the observation time.
; consolidated_debt_for_borrowed_money: Consolidated Debt for Borrowed Money of the Guarantor and its Subsidiaries at the observation time.
; consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters: Consolidated EBITDA of the Guarantor and its Subsidiaries for the four quarters most recently ended.

      (and (<= (/ consolidated_debt_for_borrowed_money consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters) 3.0)
           (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters interest_and_discount_amortization) 5.0))))

    (=> in_fq4_2006_to_fq3_2007 (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.25))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_month_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a month ("as of the last day of each month").
; unrestricted_cash_at_bank: Borrower's unrestricted cash (and equivalents) held at Bank, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; accounts: all of Borrower's Accounts, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; unpaid_equipment_advances: unpaid Equipment Advances, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; other_indebtedness_to_bank: any other indebtedness owing to Bank, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; ebitda_prev_3_months: Borrower's earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization in dollars, calculated for the previous 3 months ending at the observation date.
; monthly_pretax_loss: Borrower's pre-tax loss for the month ending at the observation date, in dollars, as a positive loss amount.
; is_feb_or_mar_2002_month: true iff the month being tested is February 2002 or March 2002.
; is_month_after_mar_2002: true iff the month being tested is after March 2002.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_month_end Bool)
    (unrestricted_cash_at_bank Real)
    (accounts Real)
    (unpaid_equipment_advances Real)
    (other_indebtedness_to_bank Real)
    (ebitda_prev_3_months Real)
    (monthly_pretax_loss Real)
    (is_feb_or_mar_2002_month Bool)
    (is_month_after_mar_2002 Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; (i) Liquidity Coverage: ratio of at least 1.50 to 1.00
    (=> is_month_end
        (>= (/ (+ unrestricted_cash_at_bank accounts)
               (+ unpaid_equipment_advances other_indebtedness_to_bank))
            1.5))
    ; (ii) EBITDA: at least $60,000 over previous 3 months
    (=> is_month_end (>= ebitda_prev_3_months 60000.0))
    ; (iii) Maximum Pre-tax Loss: at most $250,000 for Feb/Mar 2002
    (=> (and is_month_end is_feb_or_mar_2002_month)
        (<= monthly_pretax_loss 250000.0))
    ; (iii) at most $200,000 each month thereafter
    (=> (and is_month_end is_month_after_mar_2002)
        (<= monthly_pretax_loss 200000.0))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; covenant_period_started: true iff the observation date is on or after September 30, 1998 (Borrower's covenants in Section 5.01(a)-(f) begin then).
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is a fiscal-quarter test date (the quarterly test for Net Worth and Current Assets/Current Liabilities, and each fiscal quarter for the EBITDA, Leverage Ratio and debt-service tests).
; net_worth: Borrower's Net Worth in dollars at the observation.
; current_assets: Borrower's Current Assets in dollars at the observation.
; current_liabilities: Borrower's Current Liabilities in dollars at the observation.
; is_calendar_year_end_test: true iff the observation is the end of a calendar year (the Capital Expenditures test date).
; is_calendar_year_1998: true iff the calendar year being tested is 1998 (false for any later calendar year).
; capital_expenditures: Capital Expenditures made or incurred in dollars during the calendar year being tested (or the portion of it elapsed).
; is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998: true iff the fiscal quarter being tested is the quarter ending September 30, 1998 (false for quarters ending December 31, 1998 and later).
; ebitda: Borrower's EBITDA in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; total_interest_expense: total interest expense in dollars on all Indebtedness for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; principal_payments: principal payments of Indebtedness in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; leverage_ratio: Borrower's Leverage Ratio (as a plain number, x for x:1.00) for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; is_financial_reporting_deadline: true iff the observation is the 45th day after the end of a fiscal quarter ending on or after June 30, 1998.
; reports_delivered: true iff, by this observation, Borrower has provided Financial Statements for that quarter and the fiscal year to date, plus the written compliance report in the form of Exhibit P.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (covenant_period_started Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (net_worth Real)
  (current_assets Real)
  (current_liabilities Real)
  (is_calendar_year_end_test Bool)
  (is_calendar_year_1998 Bool)
  (capital_expenditures Real)
  (is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998 Bool)
  (ebitda Real)
  (total_interest_expense Real)
  (principal_payments Real)
  (leverage_ratio Real)
  (is_financial_reporting_deadline Bool)
  (reports_delivered Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ;; (a) Net Worth of not less than $35,000,000, tested quarterly
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= net_worth 35000000.0))
    ;; (b) Current Assets / Current Liabilities not less than 1.25:1.00, tested quarterly
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= (/ current_assets current_liabilities) 1.25))
    ;; (c) Capital Expenditures not in excess of $25,000,000 for 1998, $5,000,000 thereafter, tested at year end
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_calendar_year_end_test)
        (<= capital_expenditures (ite is_calendar_year_1998 25000000.0 5000000.0)))
    ;; (d) EBITDA / total interest expense not less than 2.00 (quarter ending 9/30/1998) or 3.00 (12/31/1998 and thereafter)
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= (/ ebitda total_interest_expense)
            (ite is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998 2.0 3.0)))
    ;; (e) Leverage Ratio not more than 0.75:1.00
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (<= leverage_ratio 0.75))
    ;; (f) EBITDA / (total interest expense + principal payments of Indebtedness) not less than 1.50:1.00
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= (/ ebitda (+ total_interest_expense principal_payments)) 1.5))
    ;; (g) Financial Statements and Exhibit P compliance report provided within 45 days after quarter end
    (=> is_financial_reporting_deadline reports_delivered)))

meanings.capital_expenditures: Capital Expenditures made or incurred in dollars during the calendar year being tested (or the portion of it elapsed).
meanings.is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998: true iff the fiscal quarter being tested is the quarter ending September 30, 1998 (false for quarters ending December 31, 1998 and later).
meanings.ebitda: Borrower's EBITDA in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.
meanings.total_interest_expense: total interest expense in dollars on all Indebtedness for the fiscal quarter being tested.
meanings.principal_payments: principal payments of Indebtedness in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.
meanings.leverage_ratio: Borrower's Leverage Ratio (as a plain number, x for x:1.00) for the fiscal quarter being tested.
meanings.is_financial_reporting_deadline: true iff the observation is the 45th day after the end of a fiscal quarter ending on or after June 30, 1998.
meanings.reports_delivered: true iff, by this observation, Borrower has provided Financial Statements for that quarter and the fiscal year to date, plus the written compliance report in the form of Exhibit P.

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower (quarter measurement uses company prepared consolidated financial statements).
; is_fiscal_year_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal year of the Borrower (year-end measurement uses consolidated CPA audited financial statements).
; adjusted_quick_ratio: the Borrower's Adjusted Quick Ratio at the observation date, as a plain ratio (1.00 denominator), supplied as an atomic value because no definition is given.
; total_liabilities: the Borrower's consolidated Total Liabilities at the observation date.
; undrawn_letters_of_credit: the un-drawn face amount of letters of credit outstanding as of the date the ratio is being tested.
; tangible_net_worth: the Borrower's consolidated Tangible Net Worth at the observation date.
; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: the Borrower's Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio at the observation date, as a plain ratio (1.00 denominator), supplied as an atomic value because no definition is given.

  (=> (or is_fiscal_quarter_end is_fiscal_year_end)
      (and (>= adjusted_quick_ratio 0.65)
           (<= (/ (+ total_liabilities undrawn_letters_of_credit) tangible_net_worth) 2.0)

    (=> is_fq_5_25 (<= adjusted_total_leverage_ratio 5.25))
    (=> is_fq_5_00 (<= adjusted_total_leverage_ratio 5.0))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter (Section 5.8(f)).
; indebtedness_total: Indebtedness of the Borrower and EQR (incl. Down REITs and their wholly-owned Subsidiaries; excl. other Consolidated Subsidiaries/Investment Affiliates) plus Borrower's Share of Indebtedness of Consolidated Subsidiaries and Investment Affiliates (other than Down REITs and their wholly-owned Subsidiaries); before the 5.8(a) adjustment.
; maturing_indebtedness_24m: Indebtedness that by its terms is scheduled to mature on or before the date 24 months after the calculation date.
; unrestricted_cash: Unrestricted Cash or Cash Equivalents at the calculation date.
; gross_asset_value: Gross Asset Value of the Borrower and EQR, before the 5.8(a) adjustment.
; acquisition_relief_elected: true iff the Borrower has elected the acquisition-based higher leverage limit under 5.8(a).
; in_acquisition_relief_window: true iff the observation quarter is a Fiscal Quarter in which the Borrower acquired Real Property Assets (purchase, merger or other corporate transaction), or one of the next three succeeding Fiscal Quarters.
; secured_debt_total: Secured Debt of the Borrower and EQR (incl. Down REITs and their wholly-owned Subsidiaries; excl. other Consolidated Subsidiaries/Investment Affiliates) plus Borrower's Share of Secured Debt of Consolidated Subsidiaries and Investment Affiliates (other than Down REITs and their wholly-owned Subsidiaries).
; consolidated_ebitda_ttm: Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently completed 12-month period.
; fixed_charges_ttm: Fixed Charges for the most recently completed 12-month period.
; unencumbered_asset_value: Unencumbered Asset Value.
; unsecured_debt: outstanding Unsecured Debt.
; permitted_holdings_value: aggregate value of Permitted Holdings, held directly or indirectly, without duplication, by the Borrower, EQR and/or their Subsidiaries.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (indebtedness_total Real)
  (maturing_indebtedness_24m Real)
  (unrestricted_cash Real)
  (gross_asset_value Real)
  (acquisition_relief_elected Bool)
  (in_acquisition_relief_window Bool)
  (secured_debt_total Real)
  (consolidated_ebitda_ttm Real)
  (fixed_charges_ttm Real)
  (unencumbered_asset_value Real)
  (unsecured_debt Real)
  (permitted_holdings_value Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; (a) adjusted Indebtedness / adjusted GAV <= 0.60, or <= 0.65 under the elected acquisition relief; adjustment = lesser of maturing Indebtedness and Unrestricted Cash, deducted from both
      (<= (/ (- indebtedness_total (ite (<= maturing_indebtedness_24m unrestricted_cash) maturing_indebtedness_24m unrestricted_cash))
             (- gross_asset_value (ite (<= maturing_indebtedness_24m unrestricted_cash) maturing_indebtedness_24m unrestricted_cash)))
          (ite (and acquisition_relief_elected in_acquisition_relief_window) 0.65 0.60))
      ; (b) Secured Debt / GAV <= 0.40
      (<= (/ secured_debt_total gross_asset_value) 0.40)
      ; (c) Consolidated EBITDA / Fixed Charges >= 1.50
      (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda_ttm fixed_charges_ttm) 1.50)
      ; (d) Unencumbered Asset Value / Unsecured Debt >= 1.50
      (>= (/ unencumbered_asset_value unsecured_debt) 1.50)
      ; (e) Permitted Holdings <= 35% of GAV
      (<= permitted_holdings_value (* 0.35 gross_asset_value)))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; lender_commitment_exists: true iff any Lender has any Commitment outstanding at the observation time.
; loan_obligation_unpaid: true iff any Loan or other Obligation remains unpaid or unsatisfied at the observation time.
; letter_of_credit_outstanding: true iff any Letter of Credit remains outstanding at the observation time.
; covenant_compliance_event_continuing: true iff a Covenant Compliance Event is continuing at the observation time.
; is_last_day_of_month: true iff the observation date is the last day of a calendar month.
; fccr: Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (as a ratio, 1.1:1.0 = 1.1) calculated as of the observation date for the Measurement Period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (lender_commitment_exists Bool)
  (loan_obligation_unpaid Bool)
  (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
  (covenant_compliance_event_continuing Bool)
  (is_last_day_of_month Bool)
  (fccr Real)) Bool
  (=> (and (or lender_commitment_exists loan_obligation_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding)
           covenant_compliance_event_continuing
           is_last_day_of_month)
      (>= fccr 1.1)))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff this observation is as of the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; total_funded_debt: Total Funded Debt of the Borrower at the observation time (last day of the fiscal quarter), in currency units.
; ebitda_four_quarters: EBITDA of the Borrower for the four fiscal quarters then ended, in currency units.

(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (total_funded_debt Real) (ebitda_four_quarters Real) (interest_coverage_ratio Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
      (and (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda_four_quarters) 3.25)
           (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.5))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_during_term_of_facility: true iff the observation date falls during the Term of the Facility (from the Closing date onward).
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter.
; tangible_net_worth: Holdings' consolidated Tangible Net Worth in dollars at the observation date, excluding the FIN 46 / non-subsidiary consolidated assets and liabilities.
; net_income_most_recent_quarter: Holdings' net income in dollars for the most recently ended fiscal quarter. It may be negative; only a positive value counts toward the minimum.
; equity_offering_proceeds_most_recent_quarter: aggregate dollar proceeds from any equity offerings during the most recently ended fiscal quarter.
; total_liabilities: Holdings' consolidated Total Liabilities in dollars as of the last day of the fiscal quarter, excluding the FIN 46 / non-subsidiary consolidated liabilities.
; unencumbered_unrestricted_liquid_assets: dollar level of Unencumbered and Unrestricted Liquid Assets at quarter end, including cash.
; unencumbered_unrestricted_cash: dollar amount of the Unencumbered and Unrestricted Liquid Assets that is held in cash at quarter end.
; adjusted_ebitda_rolling_four_quarters: Holdings' Adjusted EBITDA in dollars over the Relevant Accounting Period (rolling four fiscal quarters ending at the observation date).
; debt_service_rolling_four_quarters: Holdings' Debt Service in dollars over the same rolling four-quarter Relevant Accounting Period.
; estimated_current_value: Estimated Current Value in dollars, i.e. value of the real estate assets of Holdings or any wholly-owned subsidiary as set forth on Schedule G.
; holdings_notes_debt: principal amount in dollars outstanding under the Holdings Notes at the time of determination.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_during_term_of_facility Bool)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (net_income_most_recent_quarter Real)
    (equity_offering_proceeds_most_recent_quarter Real)
    (total_liabilities Real)
    (unencumbered_unrestricted_liquid_assets Real)
    (unencumbered_unrestricted_cash Real)
    (adjusted_ebitda_rolling_four_quarters Real)
    (debt_service_rolling_four_quarters Real)
    (estimated_current_value Real)
    (holdings_notes_debt Real)) Bool
  (=> (and is_during_term_of_facility is_fiscal_quarter_end)
    (and
      ; 5.02(a) minimum Tangible Net Worth
      (>= tangible_net_worth
          (+ 195118000.0
             (* 0.25 (ite (> net_income_most_recent_quarter 0.0) net_income_most_recent_quarter 0.0))
             (* 0.75 equity_offering_proceeds_most_recent_quarter)))
      ; 5.02(b) maximum Leverage Ratio: Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth not more than 2.00:1
      (<= (/ total_liabilities tangible_net_worth) 2.0)
      ; 5.02(c) minimum liquidity, of which at least $5,000,000 in cash
      (>= unencumbered_unrestricted_liquid_assets 10000000.0)
      (>= unencumbered_unrestricted_cash 5000000.0)
      ; 5.02(d) Adjusted EBITDA / Debt Service at least 2.75:1
      (>= (/ adjusted_ebitda_rolling_four_quarters debt_service_rolling_four_quarters) 2.75)
      ; 5.02(e) Holdings Notes Coverage Ratio at least 2.00:1
      (>= (/ estimated_current_value holdings_notes_debt) 2.0))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; obligations_or_commitment_outstanding: true iff any of the Obligations or Commitment remain outstanding at this observation.
; majority_lenders_written_consent: true iff the Majority Lenders have given written consent to this Acquisition.
; acquisition_being_made: true iff the Borrower or a Subsidiary makes an Acquisition (in one or more transactions) at this observation.
; aggregate_acquisition_consideration: Real, dollars. Aggregate Acquisition Consideration for all Acquisitions after the Closing Date, including the Acquisition being made.
; section_7_6_f_investments: Real, dollars. Aggregate Investments permitted under Section 7.6(f), counted together with Acquisition Consideration.
; permitted_investment_disposition_proceeds: Real, dollars. Proceeds received from the sale or other disposition of any Permitted Investment.
; total_debt_to_ebitd_ratio: Real. Total Debt to EBITD Ratio (x to 1.0) at this observation.
; this_acquisition_consideration: Real, dollars. Acquisition Consideration of the Acquisition being made.
; notice_given_five_business_days_prior: true iff the Borrower gave the Administrative Agent notice of this Acquisition, with all relevant details, at least five Business Days before making it.
; default_before_acquisition: true iff a Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing before giving effect to the Acquisition.
; default_after_acquisition: true iff a Default or Event of Default occurs and is continuing after giving effect to the Acquisition.
; acquisition_is_general_partnership_interests: true iff the Acquisition consists of general partnership interests.
; made_through_subsidiary_owning_only_gp_interests: true iff the Acquisition is made through a Subsidiary of the Borrower that owns no assets other than such general partnership interests.
; acquisition_through_subsidiary: true iff the Acquisition is made by or through a Subsidiary ("such Subsidiary").
; subsidiary_is_excluded: true iff such Subsidiary is an Excluded Subsidiary.
; stock_owned_by_borrower: true iff all outstanding Stock of such Subsidiary is directly or indirectly owned by the Borrower.
; stock_pledged_to_collateral_agent: true iff all outstanding Stock of such Subsidiary is pledged to the Collateral Agent pursuant to the Pledge Agreement.
; subsidiary_guaranty_executed: true iff such Subsidiary executes a Subsidiary Guaranty.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_or_commitment_outstanding Bool)
  (majority_lenders_written_consent Bool)
  (acquisition_being_made Bool)
  (aggregate_acquisition_consideration Real)
  (section_7_6_f_investments Real)
  (permitted_investment_disposition_proceeds Real)
  (total_debt_to_ebitd_ratio Real)
  (this_acquisition_consideration Real)
  (notice_given_five_business_days_prior Bool)
  (default_before_acquisition Bool)
  (default_after_acquisition Bool)
  (acquisition_is_general_partnership_interests Bool)
  (made_through_subsidiary_owning_only_gp_interests Bool)
  (acquisition_through_subsidiary Bool)
  (subsidiary_is_excluded Bool)
  (stock_owned_by_borrower Bool)
  (stock_pledged_to_collateral_agent Bool)
  (subsidiary_guaranty_executed Bool)) Bool

           (not majority_lenders_written_consent)
           acquisition_being_made)

            notice_given_five_business_days_prior)

        (not default_after_acquisition)

            made_through_subsidiary_owning_only_gp_interests)

        (=> (and acquisition_through_subsidiary (not subsidiary_is_excluded))
            (and stock_owned_by_borrower
                 stock_pledged_to_collateral_agent
                 subsidiary_guaranty_executed)))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; ebitda: EBITDA for the quarter then ended.
; fully_diluted_debt_service: Fully Diluted Debt Service for the quarter then ended.
; fixed_charges: Fixed Charges for the quarter then ended.
; consolidated_total_indebtedness: Consolidated Total Indebtedness at the observation time.
; consolidated_secured_indebtedness: Consolidated Secured Indebtedness at the observation time.
; market_capitalization: Market Capitalization at the observation time.
; value_unencumbered_assets: Value of Unencumbered Assets at the observation time.
; consolidated_senior_unsecured_indebtedness: Consolidated Senior Unsecured Indebtedness at the observation time.
; property_operating_income: Property Operating Income for the quarter from all Unencumbered Assets qualifying for inclusion in the Value of Unencumbered Assets, before deducting the reserve and management fee.
; capex_reserve_amount: Capital Expenditure Reserve Amount deducted in the clause (v) numerator.
; gross_revenues_excl_tenant_reimbursements: gross revenues, excluding tenant reimbursements, of those qualifying Unencumbered Assets for the quarter. The assumed management fee is 3% of this amount.
; unsecured_debt_service: the portion of Debt Service for the quarter attributable to Consolidated Unsecured Indebtedness.
; affiliate_unsecured_debt_service_share: the Borrower's pro rata share (based on economic interest) of Debt Service for the quarter attributable to unsecured indebtedness of Qualifying Investment Affiliates and Special Qualifying Investment Affiliates that own assets qualifying for the Value of Unencumbered Assets. It is counted without duplication.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (ebitda Real)
  (fully_diluted_debt_service Real)
  (fixed_charges Real)
  (consolidated_total_indebtedness Real)
  (consolidated_secured_indebtedness Real)
  (market_capitalization Real)
  (value_unencumbered_assets Real)
  (consolidated_senior_unsecured_indebtedness Real)
  (property_operating_income Real)
  (capex_reserve_amount Real)
  (gross_revenues_excl_tenant_reimbursements Real)
  (unsecured_debt_service Real)
  (affiliate_unsecured_debt_service_share Real)
) Bool
  (and
    ; (i) EBITDA / Fully Diluted Debt Service must not be less than 2.00
    (>= (/ ebitda fully_diluted_debt_service) 2.0)
    ; (ii) EBITDA / Fixed Charges must not be less than 1.75
    (>= (/ ebitda fixed_charges) 1.75)
    ; (iii) Total Indebtedness must not exceed 55% of Market Capitalization
    (<= consolidated_total_indebtedness (* 0.55 market_capitalization))
    ; (iv) Unencumbered Asset Value must not be less than 1.75x Senior Unsecured Indebtedness
    (>= value_unencumbered_assets (* 1.75 consolidated_senior_unsecured_indebtedness))
    ; (v) adjusted unencumbered NOI / unsecured debt service must not be less than 2.00
    (>= (/ (- (- property_operating_income capex_reserve_amount)
              (* 0.03 gross_revenues_excl_tenant_reimbursements))
           (+ unsecured_debt_service affiliate_unsecured_debt_service_share))
        2.0)
    ; (vi) Secured Indebtedness must not exceed 30% of Market Capitalization
    (<= consolidated_secured_indebtedness (* 0.30 market_capitalization))
  )
)

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; net_worth: Borrower's Net Worth as at that fiscal quarter end, in dollars.
; net_income: net income of the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on or most recently ended prior to the observation day.
; income_taxes: income taxes of the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries for that same four-quarter period.
; noncash_provisions_writeoffs: non-cash provisions for, or actual write-offs of, assets (without duplication in respect of any prior period) for the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries for that same four-quarter period.
; interest_on_indebtedness: all interest in respect of Indebtedness (including the interest component of Capital Lease Obligation payments) accrued or capitalized during that same four-quarter period, whether or not paid.
; net_hedging_interest_payable: net amount payable under interest-related Hedging Agreements during that same four-quarter period, signed negative if there is a net amount receivable.
; lease_interest_factor_estimate: estimate of the portion of minimum rents under operating leases representing the interest factor, for that same four-quarter period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (net_worth Real)
    (net_income Real)
    (income_taxes Real)
    (noncash_provisions_writeoffs Real)
    (interest_on_indebtedness Real)
    (net_hedging_interest_payable Real)
    (lease_interest_factor_estimate Real)
  ) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; 5.03(a): Net Worth must not be less than $1,100,000,000
      (>= net_worth 1100000000.0)
      ; 5.03(b): Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio = Cash Flow / Fixed Charges must not be less than 1.30
      ; Fixed Charges = interest_on_indebtedness + net_hedging_interest_payable + lease_interest_factor_estimate
      ; Cash Flow = net_income + income_taxes + noncash_provisions_writeoffs + Fixed Charges
      (>= (/ (+ net_income income_taxes noncash_provisions_writeoffs
                (+ interest_on_indebtedness net_hedging_interest_payable lease_interest_factor_estimate))
             (+ interest_on_indebtedness net_hedging_interest_payable lease_interest_factor_estimate))
          1.30))))

; interest_coverage_ratio: Interest Coverage Ratio for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters, taken as one accounting period, ending on the observation date (a fiscal quarter end); the ratio is expressed as X:1.0, so the value is X
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter
; in_period_sep2001_to_dec2002: true iff the observation date falls in the period September 30, 2001 through December 31, 2002
; in_period_mar2003_and_after: true iff the observation date is March 31, 2003 or later
(define-fun covenant_holds ((interest_coverage_ratio Real) (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (in_period_sep2001_to_dec2002 Bool) (in_period_mar2003_and_after Bool)) Bool
  (and
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end in_period_sep2001_to_dec2002) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.5))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end in_period_mar2003_and_after) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.75))))

; consolidated_ebitda: Consolidated EBITDA of the Company and its Subsidiaries for the four quarters most recently ended.
; interest_expense: Interest Expense of the Company and its Subsidiaries for the four quarters most recently ended.
; total_consolidated_debt: Total Consolidated Debt of the Company and its Subsidiaries at the observation time.
; q_end_2004_12_31: true iff the observation is for the quarter ending December 31, 2004.
; q_end_2005_03_31: true iff the observation is for the quarter ending March 31, 2005.
; q_end_2005_06_30: true iff the observation is for the quarter ending June 30, 2005.
; q_end_2005_09_30: true iff the observation is for the quarter ending September 30, 2005.
; q_end_2005_12_31: true iff the observation is for the quarter ending December 31, 2005.
; q_end_2006_03_31: true iff the observation is for the quarter ending March 31, 2006.
; q_end_2006_06_30: true iff the observation is for the quarter ending June 30, 2006.

  (=> (or advance_unpaid commitment_outstanding)
      (and
        (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda interest_expense) 4.25)
        (=> q_end_2004_12_31 (<= (/ total_consolidated_debt consolidated_ebitda) 4.75))
        (=> q_end_2005_03_31 (<= (/ total_consolidated_debt consolidated_ebitda) 4.5))
        (=> q_end_2005_06_30 (<= (/ total_consolidated_debt consolidated_ebitda) 4.25))
        (=> q_end_2005_09_30 (<= (/ total_consolidated_debt consolidated_ebitda) 4.0))

The Credit Parties agree that, so long as any credit is available to or in use by the Borrowers, or any of them, hereunder, except to the extent compliance in any case or cases is waived in writing pursuant to the terms of Section 13.13 hereof:\n\nSection 8.21. Financial Covenants. (i) Leverage Ratio. The Company shall not, as of the last day of each fiscal quarter of the Company, permit the Leverage Ratio to be greater than 2.50 to 1.0. (ii) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio. The Company shall not, as of the last day of each fiscal quarter of the Company, permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.25 to 1.0. (set-logic QF_LRA)
; leverage_ratio: Leverage Ratio of the Company as of the observation date (atomic Real; ratio to 1.0).
; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of the Company as of the observation date (atomic Real; ratio to 1.0).
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Company.
; is_lease_acquisition_event: True iff at this observation the Company or a Subsidiary acquires the use or possession of Property under a lease or similar arrangement.
; aggregate_lease_consideration_fy_after_effect: After giving effect to the acquisition, aggregate fixed rentals and other consideration payable by the Company and its Subsidiaries under all such leases and similar arrangements during the fiscal year, in USD, excluding Capital Leases to the extent permitted by Section 8.7(c).
; is_clean_down_test_date: True iff the observation date is April 30, the end of the January 1 to April 30 window of a year, so the clean-down test for that year is evaluated.
; clean_down_best_period_peak: In USD, the minimum, over all 60-consecutive-day periods within January 1 to April 30 of the year, of the maximum daily aggregate principal amount of Revolving Loans, Swing Loans and L/C Obligations during that period.
; is_fy_2009: True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2009.
; is_fy_2010: True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2010.
; is_fy_2011: True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2011.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((leverage_ratio Real) (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (is_lease_acquisition_event Bool) (aggregate_lease_consideration_fy_after_effect Real) (is_clean_down_test_date Bool) (clean_down_best_period_peak Real) (is_fy_2009 Bool) (is_fy_2010 Bool) (is_fy_2011 Bool)) Bool
  (and
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= leverage_ratio 2.5))
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.25))
    (=> is_lease_acquisition_event (<= aggregate_lease_consideration_fy_after_effect 10000000.0))
    (=> (and is_clean_down_test_date is_fy_2009) (<= clean_down_best_period_peak 30000000.0))
    (=> (and is_clean_down_test_date is_fy_2010) (<= clean_down_best_period_peak 27500000.0))
    (=> (and is_clean_down_test_date is_fy_2011) (<= clean_down_best_period_peak 25000000.0))))

                            (lcs_expired_and_reimbursed Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (is_quarter_on_or_after_june_30_2005 Bool)
                            (consolidated_ebitda Real)
                            (consolidated_interest_expense Real)) Bool
  (=> (and (not (and commitments_expired_or_terminated
                     loans_fees_paid_in_full
                     lcs_expired_and_reimbursed))
           is_fiscal_quarter_end
           is_quarter_on_or_after_june_30_2005)
      (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda consolidated_interest_expense) 2.25)))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; obligations_outstanding: true when the Section 6.13 covenant period is still running, i.e. the Commitments have not both expired/terminated and all Loan principal, interest and fees been paid in full, and Letters of Credit have not all expired, terminated or been collateralized, without pending draw, with all LC Disbursements reimbursed.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true when the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; is_on_or_after_2013_12_31: true when the observation date (fiscal quarter end) is on or after December 31, 2013.
; consolidated_total_indebtedness: Consolidated Total Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, consolidated, as of the observation date.
; consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, consolidated, for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending with the observed fiscal quarter end.
; consolidated_interest_expense_ttm: Consolidated Interest Expense of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, consolidated, for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending with the observed fiscal quarter end.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((obligations_outstanding Bool) (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (is_on_or_after_2013_12_31 Bool) (consolidated_total_indebtedness Real) (consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm Real) (consolidated_interest_expense_ttm Real)) Bool
  (=> (and obligations_outstanding is_fiscal_quarter_end is_on_or_after_2013_12_31)
      (and
        ; (a) Leverage Ratio must not be greater than 2.50 to 1.00
        (<= (/ consolidated_total_indebtedness consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm) 2.5)
        ; (b) Interest Coverage Ratio must not be less than 3.00 to 1.00
        (>= (/ consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm consolidated_interest_expense_ttm) 3.0))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; lender_has_commitment: true if any Lender has any Commitment outstanding at the observation time.
; obligations_unpaid: true if any Loan or other Obligation remains unpaid or unsatisfied at the observation time.
; letter_of_credit_outstanding: true if any Letter of Credit remains outstanding at the observation time.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true if the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter of the Parent.
; date_closing_through_2004_03_31: true if the observation date is from the Closing Date through March 31, 2004.
; date_2004_04_01_through_2004_09_30: true if the observation date is from April 1, 2004 through September 30, 2004.
; date_2004_10_01_through_2005_03_31: true if the observation date is from October 1, 2004 through March 31, 2005.
; date_on_or_after_2005_04_01: true if the observation date is April 1, 2005 or later.
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the end of the fiscal quarter, as a plain ratio (x to 1.00).
; consolidated_senior_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Senior Leverage Ratio as of the end of the fiscal quarter, as a plain ratio (x to 1.00).
; consolidated_fccr: Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the end of the fiscal quarter, as a plain ratio (x to 1.00).
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated Net Worth at the observation time, in dollars.

; is_fiscal_quarter_end: True iff the observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter of the Company.

; pre_fifth_quarter_reached: True iff the observed Fiscal Quarter is on or after the fifth full Fiscal Quarter following December 18, 2013 (pre-Acquisition clause (ii)).
; qualified_acquisition_window: True iff the observed Fiscal Quarter is one of the four Fiscal Quarters after a Fiscal Quarter in which a Qualified Acquisition has occurred.
; post_first_quarter_reached: True iff the observed Fiscal Quarter is on or after the first full Fiscal Quarter after the Acquisition Closing Date (post-Acquisition clause (i)).
; post_sep2015_reached: True iff the observed Fiscal Quarter is on or after the Fiscal Quarter ended on or about September 30, 2015 (post-Acquisition clause (ii)).

                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (acquisition_closing_occurred Bool)
                            (pre_first_quarter_reached Bool)
                            (pre_fifth_quarter_reached Bool)
                            (qualified_acquisition_window Bool)
                            (post_first_quarter_reached Bool)
                            (post_sep2015_reached Bool)
                            (post_mar2016_reached Bool)
                            (post_sep2016_reached Bool)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (ite (not acquisition_closing_occurred)
      (and
        (=> pre_first_quarter_reached (<= leverage_ratio 3.5))
        (=> pre_fifth_quarter_reached
            (<= leverage_ratio (ite qualified_acquisition_window 3.5 3.25))))
      (and
        (=> post_first_quarter_reached (<= leverage_ratio 5.25))
        (=> post_sep2015_reached (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))
        (=> post_mar2016_reached

meanings.qualified_acquisition_window: True iff the observed Fiscal Quarter is one of the four Fiscal Quarters after a Fiscal Quarter in which a Qualified Acquisition has occurred.
meanings.post_first_quarter_reached: True iff the observed Fiscal Quarter is on or after the first full Fiscal Quarter after the Acquisition Closing Date (post-Acquisition clause (i)).

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter.
; fc_period_1: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls in Closing Date through September 30, 2001 (Fixed Charges test).
; fc_period_2: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls in October 1, 2001 through June 30, 2002 (Fixed Charges test).
; fc_period_3: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls in July 1, 2002 through the Maturity Date (Fixed Charges test).
; consolidated_ebitr: Consolidated EBITR for the four preceding fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; fixed_charges: Fixed Charges for the four preceding fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; lev_period_1: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls in Closing Date through September 30, 2001 (Total Funded Debt to EBITDA test).
; lev_period_2: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls in October 1, 2001 through September 30, 2002 (Total Funded Debt to EBITDA test).
; lev_period_3: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls in October 1, 2002 through the Maturity Date (Total Funded Debt to EBITDA test).
; total_funded_debt: Total Funded Debt as of the last day of the fiscal quarter.
; ebitda: EBITDA for the four preceding fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated Net Worth as of the last day of the fiscal quarter.
; cum_net_income: cumulative Consolidated Net Income since March 31, 2000 (signed value as supplied).
; cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions: cumulative cash distributions of earnings of Unrestricted Subsidiaries made to a Consolidated Company after March 31, 2000, to the extent previously excluded from Consolidated Net Income or Consolidated Net Loss by clause (i) of their definitions.
; cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds: cumulative Net Proceeds from any Equity Offering consummated after March 31, 2000.
; cum_stock_repurchases: cumulative actual stock repurchases made by the Borrower after March 31, 2000 and permitted by Section 8.13.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (fc_period_1 Bool)
  (fc_period_2 Bool)
  (fc_period_3 Bool)
  (consolidated_ebitr Real)
  (fixed_charges Real)
  (lev_period_1 Bool)
  (lev_period_2 Bool)
  (lev_period_3 Bool)
  (total_funded_debt Real)
  (ebitda Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (cum_net_income Real)
  (cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions Real)
  (cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds Real)
  (cum_stock_repurchases Real)
) Bool
  (and
    ; (i) Fixed Charges: ratio must not be less than the minimum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_1) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 1.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_2) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 2.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_3) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 2.50))
    ; (ii) Total Funded Debt to EBITDA: ratio must not exceed the maximum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_1) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_2) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_3) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.25))
    ; (iii) Consolidated Net Worth must not be less than the required amount
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= consolidated_net_worth
            (- (+ 358860000.0
                  (* 0.5 cum_net_income)
                  (* 0.5 cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions)
                  cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds)
               cum_stock_repurchases)))
  )
)

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; commitments_or_advances_outstanding: true iff any Advance remains unpaid or any Lender has any Commitment at the observation time
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is the end of a fiscal quarter
; hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth: HDFS consolidated shareholder's equity net of intangible assets, USD, per Agreement Accounting Principles
; preferred_stock: preferred stock component of Consolidated Equity, USD
; subordinated_indebtedness: Subordinated Indebtedness component of Consolidated Equity, USD
; consolidated_finco_debt: Indebtedness of HDFS and its Consolidated Subsidiaries per most recent consolidated balance sheet, excluding Subordinated Indebtedness and Subordinated Intercompany Indebtedness, USD
; ebitda_net_income: net income (or net loss) of Harley and its Consolidated Subsidiaries for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD (pro forma for acquisitions/dispositions)
; consolidated_interest_expense: Harley and Consolidated Subsidiaries interest expense, cash or non-cash, including capitalized interest, for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD
; income_taxes: taxes on or measured by income, including franchise taxes in lieu of income taxes, for the four-quarter period, USD
; depreciation_expense: depreciation expense for the four-quarter period, USD
; amortization_expense: amortization expense for the four-quarter period, USD
; nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses: non-recurring cash restructuring expenses incurred in the four-quarter period, before applying the cap, USD
; is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010: true iff the four-quarter period ends on or about December 31, 2010 (cap 150,000,000)
; is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010: true iff the four-quarter period ends at the end of a fiscal year after the one ending on or about December 31, 2010 (cap 50,000,000)
; other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges: other non-cash or extraordinary charges added back for the period, USD
; cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks: cash payments made during the period on non-cash charges previously added back and paid after the quarter incurred, USD (subtracted)
; is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010: true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, June 30 or September 30, 2010
; is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010: true iff the fiscal quarter ends December 31, 2010
; is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later: true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, 2011 or any later fiscal quarter end
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitments_or_advances_outstanding Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth Real)
  (preferred_stock Real)
  (subordinated_indebtedness Real)
  (consolidated_finco_debt Real)
  (ebitda_net_income Real)
  (consolidated_interest_expense Real)
  (income_taxes Real)
  (depreciation_expense Real)
  (amortization_expense Real)
  (nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses Real)
  (is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010 Bool)
  (other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges Real)
  (cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks Real)
  (is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later Bool)
) Bool
  (=> (and commitments_or_advances_outstanding is_fiscal_quarter_end)
    (and
      ; (B) minimum Consolidated Tangible Net Worth of HDFS
      (>= hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth 500000000.0)
      ; (C) Finco Leverage Ratio = Consolidated Finco Debt / Consolidated Equity must not exceed 10.00
      (<= (/ consolidated_finco_debt
             (+ hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth preferred_stock subordinated_indebtedness))
          10.0)
      ; (D) Interest Coverage Ratio = Consolidated EBITDA / Consolidated Interest Expense must not be below the minimum
      (=> (or is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later)
        (>= (/ (- (+ ebitda_net_income
                     consolidated_interest_expense
                     income_taxes
                     depreciation_expense
                     amortization_expense
                     (ite is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010
                          (ite (<= nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses 150000000.0)
                               nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses
                               150000000.0)
                          (ite is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010
                               (ite (<= nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses 50000000.0)
                                    nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses
                                    50000000.0)
                               nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses))
                     other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges)
                  cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks)
               consolidated_interest_expense)
            (ite is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 2.0
                 (ite is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 2.25 2.5)))))))

; is_fiscal_year_1998: true if the observation time falls in Fiscal Year 1998.

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter: true iff the observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter (the end of that Fiscal Quarter).
; is_fy2000_quarter: true iff the Fiscal Quarter is in Fiscal Year 2000.
; is_fy2001_quarter: true iff the Fiscal Quarter is in Fiscal Year 2001.
; is_fy2002_quarter: true iff the Fiscal Quarter is in Fiscal Year 2002.
; is_fy2003_or_later_quarter: true iff the Fiscal Quarter is in Fiscal Year 2003 or any later Fiscal Year.
; total_debt_to_ebitda_ratio: Total Debt to EBITDA Ratio as of the quarter end (pro forma per Section 8.4(e)), as a plain number (3.50:1.00 = 3.5).
; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the quarter end (calculated per Section 8.4(e)(i)-(ii)), as a plain number.
; interest_coverage_ratio: Interest Coverage Ratio as of the quarter end (pro forma per Section 8.4(e)), as a plain number.
; net_worth: the Borrower's Net Worth as of the end of the Fiscal Quarter, in dollars (pro forma per Section 8.4(e)).
; is_prior_to_acs_consummation: true iff the observation is prior to the consummation of the ACS Acquisition, so clause (b)(i) applies.
; is_acs_quarter_or_later: true iff the observation is at the end of the Fiscal Quarter during which the ACS Acquisition occurred or any later Fiscal Quarter, so clause (b)(ii) applies.
; net_income_in_excess_of_zero_sum: aggregate Net Income in excess of zero for all Fiscal Quarters commencing with the Fiscal Quarter ending March 31, 2000, in dollars; 50% of it is added to the Net Worth floor.
; cayenta_ipo_equity_increase: net increase to the Borrower's shareholders' equity from the initial public offering of Cayenta after the Closing Date, in dollars; 80% of it is added.
; common_stock_net_cash_proceeds: net cash proceeds from the Borrower's issuance of common stock after the Closing Date, in dollars; 80% of it is added.
; is_after_cayenta_spinoff: true iff the observation is subsequent to a spin-off of Cayenta, so the Cayenta Net Worth is deducted.
; cayenta_net_worth_at_spinoff: portion of Net Worth attributable to Cayenta immediately prior to the spin-off, in dollars; deducted only if is_after_cayenta_spinoff.
; cayenta_deferred_comp_equity_decrease: net decrease to the Borrower's shareholders' equity from the deferred compensation charge on Cayenta stock options in connection with the Cayenta IPO, in dollars; deducted.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter Bool)
    (is_fy2000_quarter Bool)
    (is_fy2001_quarter Bool)
    (is_fy2002_quarter Bool)
    (is_fy2003_or_later_quarter Bool)
    (total_debt_to_ebitda_ratio Real)
    (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
    (interest_coverage_ratio Real)
    (net_worth Real)
    (is_prior_to_acs_consummation Bool)
    (is_acs_quarter_or_later Bool)
    (net_income_in_excess_of_zero_sum Real)
    (cayenta_ipo_equity_increase Real)
    (common_stock_net_cash_proceeds Real)
    (is_after_cayenta_spinoff Bool)
    (cayenta_net_worth_at_spinoff Real)
    (cayenta_deferred_comp_equity_decrease Real)
  ) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) Total Debt to EBITDA Ratio must not be greater than the scheduled maximum
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_fy2000_quarter) (<= total_debt_to_ebitda_ratio 3.5))
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_fy2001_quarter) (<= total_debt_to_ebitda_ratio 3.25))
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_fy2002_quarter) (<= total_debt_to_ebitda_ratio 3.0))
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_fy2003_or_later_quarter) (<= total_debt_to_ebitda_ratio 2.5))
    ; (b)(i) Minimum Net Worth prior to the ACS Acquisition
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_prior_to_acs_consummation)
        (>= net_worth
            (- (- (+ 80000000.0
                     (* 0.5 net_income_in_excess_of_zero_sum)
                     (* 0.8 cayenta_ipo_equity_increase)
                     (* 0.8 common_stock_net_cash_proceeds))
                  (ite is_after_cayenta_spinoff cayenta_net_worth_at_spinoff 0.0))
               cayenta_deferred_comp_equity_decrease)))
    ; (b)(ii) Minimum Net Worth from the ACS Acquisition quarter onward
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_acs_quarter_or_later)
        (>= net_worth
            (- (- (+ 115000000.0
                     (* 0.5 net_income_in_excess_of_zero_sum)
                     (* 0.8 cayenta_ipo_equity_increase)
                     (* 0.8 common_stock_net_cash_proceeds))
                  (ite is_after_cayenta_spinoff cayenta_net_worth_at_spinoff 0.0))
               cayenta_deferred_comp_equity_decrease)))
    ; (c) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio must not be less than 1.00:1.00
    (=> is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.0))
    ; (d) Interest Coverage Ratio must not be less than the scheduled minimum
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_fy2000_quarter) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.25))
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter is_fy2001_quarter) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.75))
    (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter (or is_fy2002_quarter is_fy2003_or_later_quarter)) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 4.0))
  )
)

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; Section 7.3 Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, evaluated pointwise at an observation time.
; All period amounts below cover the rolling 4 fiscal quarters ending at the observation date, for Borrower and its Subsidiaries.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) ; observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter
  (obligation_outstanding Bool) ; any Obligation is outstanding at the observation time
  (bank_commitment_exists Bool) ; the Bank has any commitment under the Agreement at the observation time
  (net_income Real) ; Borrower's GAAP net income for the rolling 4 quarters, after all expenses, cash taxes paid and other proper charges
  (noncash_addbacks Real) ; Sum of depreciation, non-cash accretion of closure/post-closure obligations and amortization, to the extent deducted in computing net income, over the rolling 4 quarters
  (cash_capital_contributions Real) ; Cash capital contributions to Borrower during the rolling 4 quarters
  (sub_debt_increase Real) ; Increase, if any, in Borrower's Subordinated Debt during the rolling 4 quarters (0 if none)
  (unfunded_capex Real) ; All unfunded capital expenditures during the rolling 4 quarters
  (sub_debt_decrease Real) ; Decrease, if any, in Borrower's Subordinated Debt during the rolling 4 quarters (0 if none)
  (fixed_charges Real) ; Principal payments owing to third parties for money borrowed, including capitalized leases, paid or scheduled to be paid during the rolling 4 quarters, including scheduled reductions in the Reducing Revolving Commitment Amount
  ) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end (or obligation_outstanding bank_commitment_exists))
      (>= (/ (- (- (+ (+ (+ net_income noncash_addbacks) cash_capital_contributions) sub_debt_increase) unfunded_capex) sub_debt_decrease)
             fixed_charges)
          1.5)))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter.
; quarter_end_on_or_after_2005_06_30: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ending on the observation date ends on or after June 30, 2005.
; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the observation date (last day of the Fiscal Quarter), as a ratio x in x:1.00, with Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA already pro forma per 6.8(f).
; leverage_ratio: Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter, as a ratio x in x:1.00, with Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA already pro forma per 6.8(f).
; lev_tier_3_25: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends June 30, 2005, September 30, 2005 or December 31, 2005.
; lev_tier_3_00: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends March 31, 2006, June 30, 2006, September 30, 2006 or December 31, 2006.
; lev_tier_2_75: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends March 31, 2007, June 30, 2007, September 30, 2007 or December 31, 2007.
; lev_tier_2_50: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends March 31, 2008, June 30, 2008, September 30, 2008 or December 31, 2008.
; lev_tier_2_25: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends on March 31, 2009 or any later date.
; fiscal_year_2005_or_later: true iff the observation falls in a Fiscal Year that is Fiscal Year 2005 or later.
; capex_current_fy: aggregate Consolidated Capital Expenditures made or incurred by Holdings and its Subsidiaries in USD in the current Fiscal Year through the observation date.
; prior_fy_is_2005_or_later: true iff the immediately preceding Fiscal Year is Fiscal Year 2005 or later.
; capex_prior_fy: aggregate Consolidated Capital Expenditures of Holdings and its Subsidiaries in USD for the immediately preceding Fiscal Year.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (quarter_end_on_or_after_2005_06_30 Bool)
    (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (lev_tier_3_25 Bool)
    (lev_tier_3_00 Bool)
    (lev_tier_2_75 Bool)
    (lev_tier_2_50 Bool)
    (lev_tier_2_25 Bool)
    (fiscal_year_2005_or_later Bool)
    (capex_current_fy Real)
    (prior_fy_is_2005_or_later Bool)
    (capex_prior_fy Real)
  ) Bool
  (and
    ; 6.8(b) minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of 1.20:1.00
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end quarter_end_on_or_after_2005_06_30)
        (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.2))
    ; 6.8(c) maximum Leverage Ratio by quarter
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end quarter_end_on_or_after_2005_06_30)
        (ite lev_tier_3_25 (<= leverage_ratio 3.25)
        (ite lev_tier_3_00 (<= leverage_ratio 3.0)
        (ite lev_tier_2_75 (<= leverage_ratio 2.75)
        (ite lev_tier_2_50 (<= leverage_ratio 2.5)
        (ite lev_tier_2_25 (<= leverage_ratio 2.25)
             true))))))
    ; 6.8(e) capex cap of 40,000,000 plus 50% of the unutilized amount of the immediately preceding Fiscal Year
    (=> fiscal_year_2005_or_later
        (<= capex_current_fy
            (+ 40000000.0
               (ite (and prior_fy_is_2005_or_later (< capex_prior_fy 40000000.0))
                    (* 0.5 (- 40000000.0 capex_prior_fy))
                    0.0))))
  )
)

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; available_cash_flow: Available Cash Flow of the Company for the Test Period ending at this observation (numerator of the ratio).
; fixed_charges: Fixed Charges for the same Test Period (denominator of the ratio).
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff this observation is the end of a fiscal quarter, i.e. the date on which a Test Period ends.
; is_on_or_after_commencement: true iff the Test Period end date is on or after December 31, 2000 (the first Test Period tested).
; in_band_closing_through_2000: true iff the Test Period end date is from the Closing Date through December 31, 2000.
; in_band_2001: true iff the Test Period end date is from January 1, 2001 through December 31, 2001.
; in_band_2002: true iff the Test Period end date is from January 1, 2002 through December 31, 2002.
; in_band_2003_and_after: true iff the Test Period end date is January 1, 2003 or later.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((available_cash_flow Real) (fixed_charges Real) (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (is_on_or_after_commencement Bool) (in_band_closing_through_2000 Bool) (in_band_2001 Bool) (in_band_2002 Bool) (in_band_2003_and_after Bool)) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_on_or_after_commencement)
      (and
        (=> in_band_closing_through_2000 (>= (/ available_cash_flow fixed_charges) 1.05))
        (=> in_band_2001 (>= (/ available_cash_flow fixed_charges) 1.10))
        (=> in_band_2002 (>= (/ available_cash_flow fixed_charges) 1.15))
        (=> in_band_2003_and_after (>= (/ available_cash_flow fixed_charges) 1.30)))))

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_outstanding_or_commitment Bool) ; True if any principal of or interest on any Loan or any other Obligation (whether or not due) remains unpaid, or any Lender has any Commitment
  (required_lenders_written_consent Bool) ; True if the Required Lenders have otherwise consented in writing to the departure from Section 6.03
  (senior_leverage_ratio Real) ; Senior Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the four consecutive fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date, as a number X for X:1.0
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) ; Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the twelve consecutive months ending on the observation date, as a number X for X:1.0
  (adjusted_consolidated_ebitda Real) ; Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA for the twelve consecutive months ending on the observation date, in the same currency units as the table amounts
  (is_end_2003_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2003
  (is_end_2004_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2004
  (is_end_2004_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2004
  (is_end_2004_09 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of September 2004
  (is_end_2004_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2004
  (is_end_2005_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2005
  (is_end_2005_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2005
  (is_end_2005_09 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of September 2005
  (is_end_2005_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2005
  (is_end_2006_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2006
  (is_end_2006_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2006
  (is_end_2006_09 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of September 2006
  (is_end_2006_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2006
  (is_end_2007_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2007
  (is_end_2007_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2007
  (is_end_after_2007_06 Bool) ; observation date is a month-end falling after June 2007 (the "Thereafter" period)
  ) Bool
  (=> (and obligations_outstanding_or_commitment (not required_lenders_written_consent))
    (and
      ; (a) Senior Leverage Ratio must not be greater than the maximum
      (=> (or is_end_2003_12 is_end_2004_03) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 3.0))
      (=> (or is_end_2004_06 is_end_2004_09 is_end_2004_12) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.75))
      (=> (or is_end_2005_03 is_end_2005_06 is_end_2005_09 is_end_2005_12 is_end_2006_03) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.5))
      (=> (or is_end_2006_06 is_end_2006_09 is_end_2006_12 is_end_2007_03 is_end_2007_06) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.25))
      (=> is_end_after_2007_06 (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.0))
      ; (b) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio must not be less than the minimum

      (=> is_end_2004_03 (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.15))

      ; (c) Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA must not be less than the minimum
      (=> is_end_2003_12 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 20834000))
      (=> is_end_2004_03 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 20517000))
      (=> is_end_2004_06 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 20992000))
      (=> is_end_2004_09 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 20921000))
      (=> is_end_2004_12 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 21018000))
      (=> is_end_2005_03 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 21373000))
      (=> is_end_2005_06 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 21852000))
      (=> is_end_2005_09 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 22587000))
      (=> is_end_2005_12 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 23253000))
      (=> is_end_2006_03 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 23563000))
      (=> is_end_2006_06 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 23982000))
      (=> is_end_2006_09 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 24624000))
      (=> is_end_2006_12 (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 25207000))
      (=> (or is_end_2007_03 is_end_2007_06 is_end_after_2007_06) (>= adjusted_consolidated_ebitda 25546000))
    )
  )
)

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_determination_date: Bool, true iff the observation date is a Determination Date.
; consolidated_current_ratio: Real, Consolidated Current Ratio as determined on the Determination Date (to 1.0).
; consolidated_tangible_net_worth: Real, Consolidated Tangible Net Worth as determined on the Determination Date, in dollars.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_mar_31_1996: Bool, true iff the observation date is the last day of a Borrower fiscal quarter occurring after March 31, 1996.
; consolidated_net_income_quarter: Real, Consolidated Net Income for the fiscal quarter then ended, in dollars (negative means deficit).
; prior_cumulative_ctnw_increase: Real, sum in dollars of all earlier step-ups to the minimum Consolidated Tangible Net Worth, each being 50% of Consolidated Net Income (or zero if a deficit) for a fiscal quarter ended after March 31, 1996 and before this observation's quarter.
; leverage_ratio: Real, Leverage Ratio as of the Determination Date (to 1.0).
; in_leverage_period_1: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the Determination Date is any quarter from the one ending June 30, 1996 through and including the one ending March 31, 1998.
; in_leverage_period_2: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the Determination Date is the one ending June 30, 1998 or any later one.
; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: Real, Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the Determination Date over its Applicable Period (to 1.0).
; fccr_q_jun_1996: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ends June 30, 1996.
; fccr_q_sep_1996: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ends September 30, 1996.
; fccr_q_dec_1996: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ends December 31, 1996.
; fccr_q_mar_jun_1997: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, 1997 through and including June 30, 1997.
; fccr_q_sep_dec_1997: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ends September 30, 1997 through and including December 31, 1997.
; fccr_q_mar_dec_1998: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, 1998 through and including December 31, 1998.
; fccr_q_mar_1999_on: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, 1999 or later.
; in_ebitda_period: Bool, true iff the Determination Date falls in the period from the Closing Date through December 31, 1996.
; ebitda_q_jun_1996: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter then ending ends June 30, 1996.
; ebitda_q_sep_1996: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter then ending ends September 30, 1996.
; ebitda_q_dec_1996: Bool, true iff the fiscal quarter then ending ends December 31, 1996.
; consolidated_operating_ebitda_quarter: Real, Consolidated Operating EBITDA for the fiscal quarter then ending, in dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_determination_date Bool)
  (consolidated_current_ratio Real)
  (consolidated_tangible_net_worth Real)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_mar_31_1996 Bool)
  (consolidated_net_income_quarter Real)
  (prior_cumulative_ctnw_increase Real)
  (leverage_ratio Real)
  (in_leverage_period_1 Bool)
  (in_leverage_period_2 Bool)
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
  (fccr_q_jun_1996 Bool)
  (fccr_q_sep_1996 Bool)
  (fccr_q_dec_1996 Bool)
  (fccr_q_mar_jun_1997 Bool)
  (fccr_q_sep_dec_1997 Bool)
  (fccr_q_mar_dec_1998 Bool)
  (fccr_q_mar_1999_on Bool)
  (in_ebitda_period Bool)
  (ebitda_q_jun_1996 Bool)
  (ebitda_q_sep_1996 Bool)
  (ebitda_q_dec_1996 Bool)
  (consolidated_operating_ebitda_quarter Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) current ratio at least 1.4
    (=> is_determination_date (>= consolidated_current_ratio 1.4))
    ; (b) tangible net worth at least 53,500,000 plus cumulative step-ups
    (=> is_determination_date
        (>= consolidated_tangible_net_worth
            (+ 53500000.0
               prior_cumulative_ctnw_increase
               (ite is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_mar_31_1996
                    (ite (> consolidated_net_income_quarter 0.0)
                         (* 0.5 consolidated_net_income_quarter)
                         0.0)
                    0.0))))
    ; (c) leverage ratio
    (=> (and is_determination_date in_leverage_period_1) (<= leverage_ratio 0.65))
    (=> (and is_determination_date in_leverage_period_2) (<= leverage_ratio 0.60))
    ; (d) fixed charge coverage ratio
    (=> (and is_determination_date fccr_q_jun_1996) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 0.80))
    (=> (and is_determination_date fccr_q_sep_1996) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 0.90))
    (=> (and is_determination_date fccr_q_dec_1996) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.0))
    (=> (and is_determination_date fccr_q_mar_jun_1997) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.1))
    (=> (and is_determination_date fccr_q_sep_dec_1997) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.2))
    (=> (and is_determination_date fccr_q_mar_dec_1998) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.3))
    (=> (and is_determination_date fccr_q_mar_1999_on) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.5))
    ; (e) Consolidated Operating EBITDA minimums
    (=> (and is_determination_date in_ebitda_period ebitda_q_jun_1996)
        (>= consolidated_operating_ebitda_quarter 13000000.0))
    (=> (and is_determination_date in_ebitda_period ebitda_q_sep_1996)
        (>= consolidated_operating_ebitda_quarter 15000000.0))
    (=> (and is_determination_date in_ebitda_period ebitda_q_dec_1996)
        (>= consolidated_operating_ebitda_quarter 16000000.0))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the measurement date for covenants 5.3(A)-(E).
; current_assets: consolidated current assets under GAAP at the observation date.
; current_liabilities: consolidated current liabilities under GAAP at the observation date.
; ebit_4q: consolidated EBIT under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date.
; interest_expense_4q: consolidated Interest Expense under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date.
; ebitda_4q: consolidated EBITDA under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period most recently ended at the observation date.
; current_portion_lt_indebtedness: current portion of long term Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, consolidated under GAAP, at the observation date.
; senior_lt_indebtedness: consolidated senior long term indebtedness under GAAP at the observation date.
; current_portion_other_lt_debt: consolidated current portion of all other long term debt (indebtedness) besides senior long term indebtedness, under GAAP, at the observation date.
; net_worth: consolidated Net Worth under GAAP at the observation date.
; existing_sub_notes_outstanding: principal amount of the Existing Subordinated Notes outstanding at the observation date, in USD; the formula caps its use at 8,500,000.
; tangible_net_worth: consolidated Tangible Net Worth under GAAP at the observation date, in USD.
; cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income: sum, over each quarterly accounting period commencing after the Closing Date through the observation date, of that quarter's net income, with loss quarters counted as zero (no deduction for losses), in USD.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (current_assets Real)
    (current_liabilities Real)
    (ebit_4q Real)
    (interest_expense_4q Real)
    (ebitda_4q Real)
    (current_portion_lt_indebtedness Real)
    (senior_lt_indebtedness Real)
    (current_portion_other_lt_debt Real)
    (net_worth Real)
    (existing_sub_notes_outstanding Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; (A) current ratio >= 1.35
      (>= (/ current_assets current_liabilities) 1.35)
      ; (B) EBIT / Interest Expense >= 2.00
      (>= (/ ebit_4q interest_expense_4q) 2.0)
      ; (C) EBITDA / (current portion of LT Indebtedness + Interest Expense) >= 1.75
      (>= (/ ebitda_4q (+ current_portion_lt_indebtedness interest_expense_4q)) 1.75)
      ; (D) (senior LT + current portion other LT) / (senior LT + current portion other LT + Net Worth + min(8,500,000, Existing Subordinated Notes outstanding)) <= 0.65
      (<= (/ (+ senior_lt_indebtedness current_portion_other_lt_debt)
             (+ senior_lt_indebtedness current_portion_other_lt_debt net_worth
                (ite (<= existing_sub_notes_outstanding 8500000.0) existing_sub_notes_outstanding 8500000.0)))
          0.65)
      ; (E) Tangible Net Worth >= 45,000,000 + 50% of cumulative net income, losses not deducted
      (>= tangible_net_worth (+ 45000000.0 (* 0.5 cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income))))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a quarter ("as of the last day of each quarter").
; quick_assets: Borrower's Quick Assets at the observation date (numerator of the Adjusted Quick Ratio).
; current_liabilities: Borrower's Current Liabilities at the observation date, before deducting deferred revenue or adding Equipment Advances.
; deferred_revenue: Borrower's deferred revenue at the observation date, subtracted from Current Liabilities in the denominator.
; long_term_equipment_advances: long-term portion of all outstanding Equipment Advances at the observation date, added to the denominator unless the step-down has occurred.
; dscr_two_quarters_maintained: true iff, as of the observation, Borrower has maintained a Debt Service Coverage Ratio of 2.0:1.0 for two consecutive quarters. When true, the long-term Equipment Advances term is eliminated and the DSCR covenant applies.
; debt_service_coverage_ratio: Borrower's Debt Service Coverage Ratio at the observation date, as a ratio to 1.0.
; tangible_net_worth: Borrower's Tangible Net Worth at the observation date, in US dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_quarter_end Bool)
                            (quick_assets Real)
                            (current_liabilities Real)
                            (deferred_revenue Real)
                            (long_term_equipment_advances Real)
                            (dscr_two_quarters_maintained Bool)
                            (debt_service_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (tangible_net_worth Real)) Bool
  (=> is_quarter_end
      (and
        ; (i) Adjusted Quick Ratio >= 2.0:1.0; denominator drops the long-term Equipment Advances after the DSCR step-down
        (>= (/ quick_assets
               (ite dscr_two_quarters_maintained
                    (- current_liabilities deferred_revenue)
                    (+ (- current_liabilities deferred_revenue) long_term_equipment_advances)))
            2.0)
        ; Concurrent DSCR covenant of 2.0:1.0 once the step-down has occurred
        (=> dscr_two_quarters_maintained (>= debt_service_coverage_ratio 2.0))
        ; (ii) Tangible Net Worth not less than $30,000,000
        (>= tangible_net_worth 30000000.0))))

  (=> is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter
      (and (=> in_period_dec2001_to_jun2004 (<= adjusted_leverage_ratio 5.0))
           (=> in_period_jul2004_to_dec2004 (<= adjusted_leverage_ratio 4.75))
           (=> in_period_jan2005_to_dec2005 (<= adjusted_leverage_ratio 4.5))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; letter_of_credit_outstanding: any Letter of Credit remains outstanding at the observation time.
; reimbursement_principal_unpaid: any principal amount of any reimbursement obligation in respect of any Letter of Credit remains unpaid or outstanding at the observation time.
; loan_principal_unpaid: any principal amount of any Loan remains unpaid or outstanding at the observation time.
; interest_unpaid: any amount of interest accrued under the Notes or in respect of any Letter of Credit remains unpaid or outstanding at the observation time.
; other_amounts_unpaid: any commitment, facility or other fee, expense, compensation or other amount payable to any member of the Bank Group under the Loan Documents remains unpaid or outstanding at the observation time.
; bank_has_commitment: any Bank has any Commitment under the agreement at the observation time.
; ebitda: Borrower EBITDA for the twelve month period ending at the observation time (currency units).
; interest_expense: Borrower Interest Expense for the same twelve month period (currency units).
; preferred_dividends_paid: dividends paid by the Borrower on its Preferred Stock during the same twelve month period (currency units).
(define-fun covenant_holds ((letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
                            (reimbursement_principal_unpaid Bool)
                            (loan_principal_unpaid Bool)
                            (interest_unpaid Bool)
                            (other_amounts_unpaid Bool)
                            (bank_has_commitment Bool)
                            (ebitda Real)
                            (interest_expense Real)
                            (preferred_dividends_paid Real)) Bool
  (=> (or letter_of_credit_outstanding
          reimbursement_principal_unpaid
          loan_principal_unpaid
          interest_unpaid
          other_amounts_unpaid
          bank_has_commitment)
      (>= (/ ebitda (+ interest_expense preferred_dividends_paid)) 2.0)))

  (compliance_period_commenced Bool) ; True if the observation is for a period ending on or after December 31, 1996, when compliance determination commences
  (is_dec_31_1997 Bool) ; True if the observation date is December 31, 1997
  (is_dec_31_1998 Bool) ; True if the observation date is December 31, 1998
  (net_profit_annual Real) ; Borrower consolidated net profit, annual basis, in US dollars, per consistently applied GAAP
  (is_quarter_end Bool) ; True if the observation is a quarterly measurement date
  (total_long_term_debt Real) ; Borrower consolidated total long term debt, in US dollars (numerator of Debt to Cash Flow Ratio)
  (ebitda_ttm Real) ; Borrower consolidated EBITDA for the prior twelve (12) month period, in US dollars (denominator of Debt to Cash Flow Ratio)
  (is_sub_debt_maturity_may_1997 Bool) ; True if the observation is at the maturity of existing subordinated debt in May, 1997

  (sub_debt_remaining Real) ; Amount of the existing subordinated debt that is maintained as subordinated debt, in US dollars
  (sub_debt_converted_to_equity Real) ; Amount of the existing subordinated debt converted to equity upon maturity, in US dollars

      (=> is_dec_31_1998 (>= net_profit_annual 400000.0))
      ; (b) Debt to Cash Flow Ratio not less than 3.0:1.0, measured quarterly

      ; (c) at May 1997 maturity, keep 75% as subordinated debt OR convert 75% to equity

        (or (>= sub_debt_remaining (* 0.75 existing_sub_debt))
            (>= sub_debt_converted_to_equity (* 0.75 existing_sub_debt))))
      ; (d) revenue earning vehicles ratio not less than 1.0:1.0, measured quarterly
