(set-logic QF_NRA)
; lender_commitment_outstanding: true if any Lender is still committed to lend or issue LCs under this agreement at the observation time.
; obligation_unpaid: true if the Obligation has not yet been fully paid and performed at the observation time.
; consent_obtained: true if Borrower has first obtained Agent's written notice of Determining Lenders' consent to the contrary for the action observed.
; has_non_permitted_debt: true if any Company has any Debt that is not Permitted Debt at the observation time.
; prepays_funded_debt: true if a Company prepaid or caused to be prepaid any principal of, or interest on, its Funded Debt at this observation.
; prepay_is_obligation: true if the prepayment is of the Obligation.
; prepay_is_refinanced_debt: true if the prepayment is of the Refinanced Debt.
; prepay_is_other_senior_debt: true if the prepayment is of a Company's other Senior Debt.
; default_or_potential_default_exists: true if a Default or Potential Default exists at the observation time.
; prepay_is_sub_conversion_to_nonredeemable_equity: true if the prepayment is a conversion of Subordinated Debt to Borrower equity that is not mandatorily redeemable.
; prepay_is_sub_for_sub_exchange: true if the prepayment is an exchange of Subordinated Debt for Subordinated Debt.
; prepay_is_sub_paid_with_new_sub_or_common: true if the prepayment is of Subordinated Debt made with proceeds of newly issued Subordinated Debt or Borrower common stock.
; prepay_is_subordinated_debt: true if the prepayment is of Subordinated Debt.
; prepay_includes_principal: true if the prepayment includes a principal prepayment.
; senior_debt_after_prepayment: Companies' Senior Debt as of the date of prepayment, immediately after giving effect to any principal prepayment.
; ebitda_four_quarters: Companies' EBITDA as of the date of prepayment, calculated on a four-consecutive-quarter basis.
; amends_subordinated_debt: true if a Company amended or modified the terms of any Subordinated Debt at this observation.
; sub_protections_less_favorable: true if the amendment makes the subordination, payment blockage, or standstill provisions less favorable to Lenders than on the date of this agreement.
; sub_terms_significantly_more_onerous: true if the amendment makes the representations, covenants, events of default, and other provisions significantly more onerous to Borrower than on the date of this agreement.
; sub_early_principal_payments_added: true if the amendment makes scheduled or mandatory principal or sinking fund payment obligations before November 30, 1998 applicable to any Subordinated Debt.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (lender_commitment_outstanding Bool)
  (obligation_unpaid Bool)
  (consent_obtained Bool)
  (has_non_permitted_debt Bool)
  (prepays_funded_debt Bool)
  (prepay_is_obligation Bool)
  (prepay_is_refinanced_debt Bool)
  (prepay_is_other_senior_debt Bool)
  (default_or_potential_default_exists Bool)
  (prepay_is_sub_conversion_to_nonredeemable_equity Bool)
  (prepay_is_sub_for_sub_exchange Bool)
  (prepay_is_sub_paid_with_new_sub_or_common Bool)
  (prepay_is_subordinated_debt Bool)
  (prepay_includes_principal Bool)
  (senior_debt_after_prepayment Real)
  (ebitda_four_quarters Real)
  (amends_subordinated_debt Bool)
  (sub_protections_less_favorable Bool)
  (sub_terms_significantly_more_onerous Bool)
  (sub_early_principal_payments_added Bool)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or lender_commitment_outstanding obligation_unpaid)
           (not consent_obtained))
      (and
        ; (a) no Debt except Permitted Debt
        (not has_non_permitted_debt)
        ; (b) no Funded Debt prepayment except the listed exceptions
        (=> prepays_funded_debt
            (or prepay_is_obligation
                prepay_is_refinanced_debt
                (and prepay_is_other_senior_debt (not default_or_potential_default_exists))
                prepay_is_sub_conversion_to_nonredeemable_equity
                prepay_is_sub_for_sub_exchange
                prepay_is_sub_paid_with_new_sub_or_common
                (and prepay_is_subordinated_debt
                     (not default_or_potential_default_exists)
                     (or (not prepay_includes_principal)
                         (<= (/ senior_debt_after_prepayment ebitda_four_quarters) 2.75)))))
        ; (c) no prohibited amendment of Subordinated Debt terms
        (=> amends_subordinated_debt
            (not (or sub_protections_less_favorable
                     sub_terms_significantly_more_onerous
                     sub_early_principal_payments_added))))))

  (dividends Real)

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; banks_obligated_to_lend: true iff the Banks are still obligated to lend under the agreement at this observation.
; notes_and_interest_unpaid: true iff the Notes and interest thereon have not yet been paid in full at this observation.
; prior_written_consent_obtained: true iff the Borrower has the Banks' prior written consent to permit the interest coverage ratio to be below 1.3 to 1.0 at this observation.
; consolidated_net_income: Consolidated Net Income over the four-quarter rolling period ending at this observation.
; consolidated_net_interest_expense: Consolidated Net Interest Expense over the same four-quarter rolling period. It is added back in the numerator and is also the denominator.
; consolidated_taxes: consolidated taxes over the same four-quarter rolling period.
; consolidated_amortization: consolidated amortization over the same four-quarter rolling period.
; consolidated_depreciation: consolidated depreciation over the same four-quarter rolling period.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((banks_obligated_to_lend Bool)
                            (notes_and_interest_unpaid Bool)
                            (prior_written_consent_obtained Bool)
                            (consolidated_net_income Real)
                            (consolidated_net_interest_expense Real)
                            (consolidated_taxes Real)
                            (consolidated_amortization Real)
                            (consolidated_depreciation Real)) Bool
  (=> (and (or banks_obligated_to_lend notes_and_interest_unpaid)
           (not prior_written_consent_obtained))
      (>= (/ (+ consolidated_net_income
                consolidated_net_interest_expense
                consolidated_taxes
                consolidated_amortization
                consolidated_depreciation)
             consolidated_net_interest_expense)
          1.3)))
